Location Details: United States, Remote

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.

This position is not eligible to be performed in Alaska, Mississippi, North Dakota, or the Virgin Islands.

GoDaddy is not currently considering candidates for this role in California, Seattle, or NYC.

Join our team

GoDaddy is in the middle of a significant product transformation. Roughly two-thirds of our product development work now involves artificial intelligence, and the questions our product teams need answered have changed fundamentally. We're no longer just evaluating interfaces. But the dynamic human-AI systems: whether they're useful, trustworthy, recoverable, and understood by the customers who depend on them.

We are seeking a Director UX Research for the Product Experience group to join our team! Partnering directly with collaborators across business functions, your mandate is twofold. Set and uphold the research standard for user experience professionals conducting generative and iterative research. Support partner teams doing small-batch testing. Additionally, personally lead strategic and AI evaluation work that demands dedicated research depth.

This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a research queue. It's for a leader who sees research as both a customer intelligence capability and a product quality system and who knows how to operate both at the speed modern product development demands. GoDaddy's UX designers are capable practitioners who handle a significant volume of discovery and evaluative research. The research team's value is highest where that work can't go: complex AI experience evaluation, cross-product synthesis, foundational understanding of customer behavior, and the strategic questions that require dedicated depth!

What you'll get to do...

Research Strategy and Prioritization

  • Define a research agenda that sits ahead of product roadmaps, not behind them — identifying the questions that need to be answered before key product and architectural decisions are made
  • Partner with Product, Build, and senior Engineering management to align research priorities against product risk, customer impact, and AI complexity
  • Distinguish between what the research team should own directly and what the broader UX community can handle with the right support
  • Help GoDaddy continue to mature in how it uses AI to test, validate, and accelerate insight generation — developing a point of view on where AI-assisted methods are appropriate and where human judgment remains essential
  • Represent research as a key influence on product direction, not a validation step after building

AI Evaluation and Emerging Experience Research

  • Lead research into the human dimensions of GoDaddy's AI products: how customers understand, trust, accurately address, adapt to, and recover from experiences involving artificial intelligence
  • Partner on evaluation frameworks for agentic and AI-assisted features — contributing methodological expertise on trust, control, edge cases, and live-product monitoring — before and after launch
  • Bring leadership to research questions that don't have established playbooks: prompt and workflow analysis, human-in-the-loop testing, behavioral data interpretation in AI contexts
  • Stay current on AI-experience research methods and bring that knowledge into the team and the wider build group

Standards, Enablement, and Research Craft

  • Set the research quality bar for the entire Product UX organization. This includes UX designers conducting generative and iterative research, as well as partner teams running their own small-batch testing.
  • Refine existing frameworks, guardrails, and playbooks so that designers and partner teams can run clean discovery: when directional research is enough, when it isn't, how to synthesize and share findings, so they compound across the org
  • Lead all aspects of the continued development of UX designers running research — building research craft, raising quality standards, and driving the integration of AI research tools and methodologies into how the broader design organization works
  • Ensure shared infrastructure remains current and usable: repositories, taxonomies, participant panels, consent and data governance standards, AI-assisted workflows

Team Leadership and Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a research team that includes both existing researchers and new hires
  • Build toward complementary strengths across the team: generative and assessment-focused research, quantitative and mixed-methods capability, AI evaluation proficiency, and research operations
  • Mentor UX researchers directly on craft, career development, and the evolving demands of researching technology-enhanced product experiences
  • Build a culture where rigor and velocity are treated as compatible, not competing, where "directional and fast" and "deep and strategic" are both valued depending on the decision at stake

Cross-Functional and Organizational Influence

  • Operate as a peer to the Design, Product, and Engineering leaders — shaping product strategy, not just informing it
  • Partner with different departments to ensure research is connected to commercial priorities, not siloed within the build organization
  • Build organizational confidence that product decisions are grounded in real customer understanding, particularly as AI capabilities expand faster than product intuition can track

Your experience should include...

  • 10+ years of UX or user research experience, with demonstrated proficiency in mixed-methods approaches
  • 4+ years leading research teams, with direct responsibility for hiring, mentoring, and performance development
  • Meaningful experience researching AI-driven, technically complex, or developer-facing products
  • Track record of refining and operationalizing research standards, frameworks, or enablement tools that extended research quality beyond the immediate research team
  • Experience operating as a strategic partner to Product and Engineering leadership, not just delivering studies but shaping direction
  • Experience partnering with various departments beyond just a build or product organization

You might also have...

  • Experience in enterprise SaaS, SMB products, or multi-product platforms where research prioritization across a large portfolio was a core challenge
  • Familiarity with research operations at scale: participant recruiting infrastructure, insight repositories, governance frameworks
  • Proficiency working with behavioral data, product analytics, or telemetry alongside qualitative findings
  • Background in human-computer interaction, cognitive psychology, behavioral science, or related fields

We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.

About us... GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models, from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings, helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We have led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we are building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

The Opportunity

Zuora and Workday now sell Zuora Billing and Revenue together under one Workday contract. This role makes that partnership win technically in Workday Financial Management (FINS) accounts, both net-new and existing. You will work alongside Workday and Zuora AEs, Workday FINS specialists and value consultants, and you will own the technical win.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical win on Workday FINS opportunities: discovery, architecture, objection handling, and clear positioning of Zuora against Workday-native billing and revenue options
  • Map the quote-to-cash and usage model end to end across Workday Revenue Management, Accounting Center, Close & Consolidate, and Services CPQ, showing where Zuora owns metering, rating, mediation, and invoice presentation and where data hands off to Workday
  • Scope and build proofs of concept as the primary mechanism for technical proof, with a forward-deployed engineer mindset, working hands-on with APIs, events, and data integrations between Zuora and Workday tenants
  • Design consumption and AI-driven monetization for Workday customers: prepaid drawdown, flexible commitments, and usage pricing, with the revenue recognition implications made explicit
  • Enable Workday field teams, including FINS sellers, specialists, and consultants, through joint discovery, demos, and certification-ready technical materials
  • Lead C-level technical presentations, translating pricing and architecture trade-offs into business value for CFOs, controllers, and CIOs
  • Stay close to accounts post-sale to protect technical health, drive adoption, and surface share-of-wallet and suite expansion opportunities
  • Share structured customer and field feedback with Product and Solutions teams to shape the Workday integration roadmap
  • Support RFPs, RFIs, joint field events, and customer references as needed
  • Travel within your territory as required

About You

You are a technical solutions professional who has won complex deals alongside Workday or ERP partners and can run a POC without hand-holding.

You bring:

  • 7+ years in sales engineering, presales, or solution architecture in enterprise SaaS
  • Hands-on experience with Workday Financial Management, or with another enterprise ERP and its finance modules (Revenue, Accounting, Close, CPQ), in a partner or co-sell setting
  • Working knowledge of revenue recognition (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) and how it shapes billing and usage models
  • Deep fluency in usage and consumption billing: metering, rating, mediation, prepaid drawdown, and commitment pricing
  • Strong technical depth across REST APIs, event-driven integration, data reconciliation, and ERP-to-billing data flows
  • The ability to troubleshoot a failing integration under pressure, not just describe the architecture
  • Executive communication with CFOs, controllers, and CIOs, and with engineers
  • Experience with MEDDIC or Value Selling
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in FinTech or enterprise software

A strong plus:

  • Workday Financial Management certification, or Workday Revenue Management and Accounting Center experience
  • Experience co-selling with a platform partner's AEs and SEs
  • Telecom or high-volume usage experience

About the Team

You will sit in the Workday alliance solutions group, working with Account Executives from Zuora and Workday, Workday FINS specialists and value consultants, Product, and Solutions. The group exists to win and expand Zuora + Workday Financial Management accounts with a technical story that holds up in front of controllers and CFOs.

The team wants someone who goes beyond standard demos: someone who will shape the solution architecture, own the POC outcome, and help turn Workday's customer base into durable consumption revenue for Zuora.

Benefits

Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs' wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. Specific offerings vary by country, but we typically provide:

  • Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company-wide year-end break
  • Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
  • Learning & development stipend to support ongoing growth
  • Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available
  • Mental wellbeing resources and support

Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process.

#ZEOLife at Zuora

Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants needing special assistance or accommodation during the interview process may email assistance@zuora.com (or local equivalent).

Compensation

The OTE range for this role is $142,350 - $251,160. OTE includes base salary and target variable compensation. A candidate’s final OTE will be determined based on factors including qualifications, relevant experience, job-related knowledge, specific skills, location and budget.

The base pay details represent the annualized salary range for the posted position. While we share a comprehensive range, a candidate’s final base salary will fall within these guidelines and will be determined based on multiple factors including but not limited to: qualifications of the candidate, job related knowledge, prior related experience, specific and unique skills, the location of the role, internal equity and internal budget. Base pay is only one element of Zuora’s Total Rewards Package. Additional elements may also include bonus/variable compensation, equity and comprehensive benefits, more details found here.

Base Pay Details

$109,500—$193,200 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As the Principal Product Manager, Network Economics at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

BetterHelp is looking for a principal-level individual contributor to own therapist compensation and incentives: the economic mechanisms that determine whether a client who needs care can find the right therapist, in their state, under their plan, as soon as possible. We match hundreds of thousands of clients to licensed therapists across every state and a growing set of insurance plans. How quickly that match happens comes down to the strength, size, and variety of our therapist population, and how quickly we can shift it toward the plans and states where clients are waiting.

This individual will own the mechanisms that drive that supply pool, compensation rates, structure, and incentives, as a product and be accountable for the business outcome, not just the shipped feature. That means close collaboration with cross functional stakeholders, deriving defensible answers to how much therapist capacity we actually need and where, and experiments that tell us how the network responds when we change what it earns.

It’s an exciting opportunity for someone who is deeply analytical and does their best work in ambiguity: able to take a problem where the data is incomplete and the stakeholders don’t yet agree, and still reach an effective outcome with the organization behind it. The problems here sit where product, economics, and clinical operations meet, all while making a difference in the lives of people seeking mental health care.

What will you do?

  • Own the incentive system that moves therapist availability toward where clients actually need it, designed to be targeted, measurable, and reversible
  • Own the structure and clarity of the compensation model itself: what a therapist can predict about their earnings, and what the model rewards them for
  • Define what “well supplied” means for a network like ours, and build the tools and features that close the gap
  • Build a compelling and sustainable earnings proposition for therapists, and use controlled rollouts and rigorous measurement to learn what actually moves availability before we commit to it, all within the realities of a licensed, independent clinical workforce
  • Incentivize the specific behaviors that create client access, including therapist availability, match acceptance, and continuity of care
  • Analyze and quantify the impact of every change we make, then draw conclusions and plan next steps based on actual data
  • Partner closely with matching, eligibility, member experience, therapist experience, and provider acquisition. Your systems and theirs depend on each other
  • Work cross-functionally with finance, clinical, legal, marketing, data science, and operations, who have a stake in nearly everything this role touches, to get a change designed, approved, launched, and measured
  • Participate in setting the strategy and long-term direction for the organization, both within and beyond the context of product
  • Own KPI’s and be obsessed about them
  • In a nutshell: Diagnose, model, design, test, measure, decide, systematize

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.
  • You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.
  • You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
  • You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome to apply. We ask employees to travel to our San Jose, CA office up to three times per year plus one company-wide offsite to collaborate in person and strengthen working relationships. Travel expenses are covered and reasonable accommodations are made for those under unique circumstances who cannot travel.

Requirements

  • 8-10 years experience in a product role with proven success through measurable impact and increasing responsibilities, including experience owning pricing, incentives, payouts, or supply-side economics in a two-sided marketplace
  • Super analytical: you can build the model, defend it in a room with data science, and explain it to a CFO without losing either audience
  • Deep understanding of unit and business economics, and a proven ability to balance business, clinical, and technical considerations in a product decision
  • You know which decisions to test cheaply and which ones you only get to make once, and you can tell the difference under time pressure
  • Strong understanding of marketplace dynamics and two-sided marketplace business models
  • Sound judgment in ambiguity. You can tell when the evidence is good enough to act on and when the right move is to dig deeper, and you can explain which call you’re making and why
  • A track record of driving cross-functional decisions to a conclusion without authority over the people who have to agree
  • Excellent written communication. Much of this role is making a quantitative argument that an executive audience can act on
  • Excellent organizational and leadership skills, strong attention to detail, able to work independently

Bonus (Great to have, but not required):

  • Experience with supply-side economics in a marketplace where supply is labor: ride-hail, delivery, or a professional services marketplace
  • Experience compensating an independent contractor workforce, and familiarity with the constraints that come with it
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, or another business where eligibility and payer rules shape who can serve whom
  • Fluency with experimentation and causal inference where clean randomization isn’t always available

Benefits

  • Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company
  • Competitive compensation
  • Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution
  • The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love
  • Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive
  • An awesome community of co-workers

The base salary range for this position is $210,000 - $250,000. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions.

We will never ask you for money, gift cards, or any form of payment during our hiring process, and we will never send money or checks to candidates. If you experience this, it is a scam.

jobs.jobDescription:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Communications APIs:

As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more. As businesses continue to shift to a real-time, customer-centric communications model, we are experiencing a time of impressive growth.

Why this role matters

Platform engineering sits at the heart of how software gets built at scale, and this team will help define how Vonage works. You will lead a group of engineers who are directly responsible for the platforms, workflows, and automation that the wider engineering organisation depends on every day. The organisation is going through a meaningful platform evolution: modernising tooling, raising the automation ceiling, and standardising how engineering teams ship software at scale. There is real work to do, real complexity to navigate, and a real mandate to make things better. This is a role for an engineering manager who wants to lead through change as Vonage continues to drive innovation. You will lead a globally distributed engineering team focused on growing engineers and delivering in a complex, high-stakes environment where your work is felt every day.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to write and review production code, contribute to architecture decisions, and participate directly in the on-call rotation — not only manage others who do those things.

Your key responsibilities

  • Lead the EU/US Platform Engineering team – Provide day-to-day people management and technical leadership for a geographically distributed team of platform engineers.

  • Stay hands-on technically – Write and review production code, contribute to technical and architecture decisions, and work directly with the team on complex engineering challenges.

  • Drive the roadmap forward – Execute the roadmap under the direction of the Director of Engineering and Product Owner, ensuring deliverables are not blocked by external dependencies.

  • Develop your people – Team members are transitioning from SRE/infrastructure backgrounds into platform product engineering; you will coach and grow them toward ownership, customer-first thinking, and modern platform development practices.

  • Coordinate large-scale cross-team changes – Own the coordination of platform-wide changes such as Kubernetes upgrades, tooling migrations, and security hardening that touch many teams and require alignment across multiple stakeholders and time zones.

  • Operate within compliance and security constraints – Ensure all platform work meets security and regulatory requirements while maintaining appropriate guardrails and policies.

  • Be data-driven – Establish and track SLAs, error budgets, KPIs, and change failure rates; use metrics to prioritise work, communicate platform health to stakeholders, and continuously improve the team's delivery velocity.

  • Maintain platform reliability – Participate directly in the on-call rotation with your team and set the standard for operational excellence, incident response, and production ownership.

  • Partner with architects and product – Work closely with the Chief Architect (US-based), Director of Engineering, and Product Owner on platform direction, architecture, and prioritisation.

What you'll bring

Required

  • 2+ years of engineering management experience leading platform, DevOps, or SRE teams.

  • A strong hands-on engineering background before moving into management – You have personally written and shipped production code, owned systems end-to-end, and debugged production issues.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes-based platforms (EKS preferred), including cluster lifecycle management, upgrades at scale, operational troubleshooting, and cross-team rollout coordination.

  • Strong hands-on experience with the AWS ecosystem and a solid understanding of how AWS services underpin enterprise platform infrastructure.

  • Proven ability to lead and grow engineers through skill transitions, especially from operational/SRE roles into product-oriented platform engineering.

  • A genuine dependency-unblocking mindset – You know how to drive cross-team commitments, escalate constructively, and keep complex multi-team deliverables on track.

  • A data-driven approach to platform management – You are comfortable defining and tracking SLAs, KPIs, change failure rates, and error budgets.

  • Familiarity with compliance and security constraints in a regulated environment – You do not treat them as blockers but as guardrails to engineer around.

  • Strong leadership instincts – You set a high bar, give clear feedback, and build psychological safety.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Port.io, OpsLevel, or a similar Internal Developer Platform product.

  • Familiarity with GitOps tooling such as ArgoCD, Crossplane, or Kyverno.

  • AWS and/or Kubernetes certifications.

  • Experience in CFIUS-regulated or similarly complex compliance environments.

How you’ll benefit:

  • Private Medical Insurance with the option to add dependents
  • Multisport Gym Membership
  • Educational Assistance Reimbursement Program
  • Lunch and Learn Sessions held monthly
  • Opportunity to be reimbursed for conferences, trainings, and other events consistent with the area of work aimed at personal development
  • Three Paid Volunteer Days a Year
  • Unlimited Discretionary Time Off
  • Additional Maternity and Paternity Leave

#LI-YB1

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

jobs.jobDescription:
Role Description

As an Implementation Architect at Dropbox, you will help customers successfully configure, implement, and launch Dropbox solutions across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise environments.You will own multiple concurrent implementations, guiding customers through configuration, integrations, identity setup, migrations, testing, enablement, go-live, and post-launch handoff. You will translate agreed solution designs into practical implementation plans, identify risks early, troubleshoot common technical issues, and keep customers and internal teams aligned through delivery.

This role is designed for someone with hands-on experience implementing SaaS products who can independently deliver standard and moderately complex implementations using established approaches. You will work closely with Technical Architects, Customer Success, Support, Sales, and partners. You will also help improve implementation consistency by contributing lessons learned, reusable documentation, and practical feedback from customer deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Own several concurrent customer implementations from kickoff through configuration, testing, go-live, and post-launch handoff.
  • Translate agreed solution designs and customer requirements into clear implementation plans, milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support enterprise identity and access use cases including SSO/SAML, SCIM, identity provisioning, and permission configuration.
  • Lead customer implementation workshops, technical working sessions, status meetings, enablement sessions, and implementation handoffs.
  • Troubleshoot implementation issues using established tools, documentation, and escalation paths; identify when issues require support from Technical Architecture, Engineering, Security, Product, or Support.
  • Document implementation decisions, configurations, testing results, risks, and handoff requirements clearly for customers and internal teams.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Samsara Technical Account Manager (TAM), you are the cornerstone of technical customer success. In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, moving beyond traditional support to deliver measurable business value and drive the long-term adoption of the Samsara platform. Your mission is to proactively optimize your customers' technical health and mitigate risk, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes.

This requires a unique blend of deep technical acumen, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to communicate with influence across both technical and executive stakeholders. You will build enduring customer relationships by translating their operational goals into powerful technical solutions. As the primary technical interface for your accounts, you will foster cross-functional collaboration with our Sales, Support, and Product teams to champion your customers' needs. During critical incidents, you will demonstrate ownership by managing customer communications and expectations through to a successful resolution.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Mexico.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive Customer Impact & Value Realization: Go beyond technical support to consistently deliver measurable value. You will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business objectives and proactively align Samsara's solutions to help them achieve their goals, tracking and demonstrating technical ROI along the way.
  • Use AI to Transform the Customer Experience: Leverage AI-powered tools and insights to anticipate customer needs, personalize engagement, and deliver faster, more proactive, and impactful outcomes.
  • Execute Transformational Technical Account Management: Independently manage a portfolio of accounts, developing tailored success plans and identifying and mitigating risks to customer health. You will maintain accurate records of customer interactions and contribute to team-wide objectives.
  • Demonstrate Deep Technical Acumen & Samsara Expertise: Be the primary technical point of contact, mastering Samsara's platform, including APIs, hardware, and software. You will advise customers on best practices and troubleshoot complex technical issues with proficiency.
  • Provide Consultative Problem Solving & Solutioning: Employ a consultative approach to understand the root cause of customer challenges. You will own the technical ticket lifecycle, including technical escalations from report to resolution, and conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and drive product improvement.
  • Communicate with Influence and Clarity: Lead customer meetings, from technical deep dives to quarterly technical account reviews, with confidence. You will adapt your communication style to effectively engage with diverse audiences, from technical staff to non-technical executives.
  • Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and deliver a unified experience.
  • Demonstrate Ownership and Act as a Multiplier: Embody a 'get it done' mentality by taking initiative on team projects and process improvements. You will actively contribute to our internal knowledge base and help onboard new team members, sharing best practices to enhance the entire team's capabilities.
  • Embody Samsara's Values & Principles: Consistently champion and role model Samsara's core values and operating principles in every interaction, actively seeking feedback for continuous improvement

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Experience: 7+ years experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, solutions consulting, or customer success, with a demonstrated track record of success.
  • Education: We welcome applications from candidates with a bachelor's degree in a technical field, or those who have gained equivalent expertise through practical experience in areas such as Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Technical Proficiency: Exceptional technical literacy with the ability to understand and troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and API integrations. A strong passion for technology and a commitment to continuous learning, including an interest in AI and its applications.
  • Bilingual: English and Spanish is a must.
  • Customer Focus: A data-informed approach to understanding customer needs and a demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish is required.
  • Collaborative Spirit: A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and works effectively with internal teams to drive customer success.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience supporting global enterprise-level customers in a SaaS, IoT, or PaaS environment.
  • Proven experience leveraging AI tools and methodologies in daily workflows to drive efficiency, generate customer insights, and improve overall customer success.
  • Prior experience with Samsara, Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Gong, Gainsight, and Tableau.
  • Basic Python coding skills are an asset for providing enhanced technical solutions

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.jobDescription:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About CookUnity

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team:

Our Growth Platform team brings together Engagement and Accounts & Identity to build the experiences and technical foundations that help customers start, deepen, and renew their relationship with CookUnity.

On the Engagement side, we help new customers build lasting habits, keep active customers engaged, grow through referrals, and welcome back customers who have left. On the Accounts & Identity side, we own the services that power customer accounts, authentication, and secure access across our products, providing reliable capabilities that other engineering teams build upon.

Our work spans customer experiences across web and mobile, shared backend services, and the evolution of our platform into scalable, independent systems. We partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering to experiment, measure outcomes, and turn successful ideas into lasting capabilities. For engineers, this means combining direct customer impact with deep technical ownership, making CookUnity easier to use while helping teams across the company build and move faster.

The role:

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Backend oriented) on our Growth Platform team, you will help shape and own the core services behind Accounts & Identity, including authentication, user accounts, and the foundations of a shared notification system.

Working closely with our Staff Engineer, you will take ownership from technical design through implementation, rollout, and operation in production. You will evolve our authentication platform and User Service, build reliable integrations across services, and establish reusable capabilities that enable product teams to deliver timely, relevant notifications across channels.

This role calls for strong backend engineering expertise and sound judgment around distributed systems, database design, performance, and real-time and event-driven architectures. You should be comfortable investigating slow queries, designing APIs and asynchronous workflows, and making practical tradeoffs around consistency, scalability, security, and reliability.

You will partner with engineers across CookUnity to understand their needs and turn them into clear service boundaries and dependable integrations. Your impact will come from both delivering new capabilities and ensuring that the systems other teams depend on remain fast, observable, and easy to build upon.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the design, implementation, and operation of core backend services across authentication, identity, and user account management.
  • Partner with our Staff Engineer to define technical direction, make architecture decisions, and deliver projects from discovery through production.
  • Build the foundations of a shared notification system, including event processing, delivery workflows, and integrations with messaging providers.
  • Design APIs and service integrations with clear contracts, reliable failure handling, and well-defined ownership.
  • Improve performance and scalability through database design, query optimization, indexing, caching, and efficient data access patterns.
  • Build asynchronous and real-time capabilities, accounting for retries, idempotency, ordering, and data consistency.
  • Evolve legacy functionality into independent services, planning safe migrations that preserve data integrity and service availability.
  • Protect customer data through secure authentication, authorization, and access management practices.
  • Establish meaningful automated tests, observability, and rollout strategies, and participate in incident response and the on-call rotation.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to translate business needs into reusable platform capabilities, review code, and mentor other engineers.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong focus on backend services and production systems.
  • Strong backend development experience with both Kotlin/Java and Node.js with TypeScript, including building and operating production services. Deep expertise in at least one stack and the ability to contribute independently in the other.
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases, including data modeling, indexing, query optimization, transactions, and safe schema migrations.
  • Experience building distributed systems and asynchronous workflows, with an understanding of retries, idempotency, and data consistency.
  • Experience diagnosing and improving backend performance using metrics, logs, traces, and profiling.
  • Familiarity with authentication and authorization concepts, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and secure session management.
  • Experience integrating internal services and third-party APIs, with thoughtful handling of failures and service dependencies.
  • A track record of owning projects from technical design through testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Clear communication skills, advanced English, and the ability to collaborate on technical decisions and explain tradeoffs.

Benefits

💸 Get paid in USD

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Paid Family leave

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

🧘🏽‍♀️ Customize the benefits that suit your needs! Access a range of perks tailored to you, including learning opportunities, wellness memberships, delivery apps, and more through our comprehensive benefit platform

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

  • Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com
  • Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.
  • We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.
  • We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

  • 💻 Fully remote work with hardware provided

  • 🌎 Global team experience with clients in North America

  • 💸 Competitive USD compensation

  • 📚 Training and learning stipends

  • 🌴 Paid Time Off (vacation, personal, study)

  • 🧘‍♂️ A culture that values autonomy, purpose, and human connection

Compliance & Equal Opportunity

Launchpad is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable laws in Canada and British Columbia.

All candidate information will be handled confidentially and used solely for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

Ready to make your mark? Apply now and be part of something exciting!

The CookUnity Product Support Team plays a crucial role as the initial responders to customer-related issues, coordinating efforts among various teams and ensuring stakeholders stay updated. They take charge of the Incident Management process, emphasizing the importance of learning from any system outages or disruptions.

The Role:

We are looking for a Product Support Engineer with solid analytical and problem-solving skills, capable of communicating effectively with tech and business areas, along with having a strong level of technical background in technical troubleshooting and run database SQL queries.

The Product Support Engineer owns the tracking of any incident that may impact our systems. They are also responsible for calculating and sharing the impact while ensuring all stakeholders are kept informed of every update throughout the investigation.

You'll be reporting directly to our Product Support Manager and you will participate together in the definition of OKRs, constant improvements, monitoring, Incident Management, and help with the expansion of the team as our operation keeps doing so nationwide.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the Product Support Backlog.
  • Keep the CX, Engineering, and Business teams up-to-date.
  • Quick-solve issues escalated by the 1st support level (CX team).
  • Regularly check our monitoring tools, respond to alerts, and create new monitors when necessary.
  • Be a part of the Incident Management and post-mortem processes (detection, creation of an Incident, research, follow-up).
  • Build detailed reports on KPIs and trends.
  • Availability for the on-call rotation.

Requirements:

  • More than 4 years of experience as a product support analyst, business analyst, functional analyst, data analyst, or related field.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Experience running or being responsible for Incident Response/management processes.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Problem-solving and a DO-er skills.
  • You are familiar with Agile Methodologies, and you know how to write detailed user stories.
  • Be able to run intermediate SQL queries.
  • Knowledge of an API tool like Postman and being able to perform basic tests with it.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Enterprise sales team is responsible for revenue growth in new and existing customers that represent the largest prospective accounts for Samsara by total addressable opportunity.

This is a remote position, open to candidates based in Mexico.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts.
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close.
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $500k+ ARR transactions
  • Experience handling and owning enterprise deal sizes and C-Level relationships
  • Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability thriving in a dynamic, fast paced environment
  • Mexico citizen
  • Fluency in both Spanish and English

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)
  • Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)
  • Passion for the world of operations!

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. An overview of this role

As a Renewal Manager, you'll own the end-to-end renewal lifecycle for a defined portfolio of GitLab customers, protecting and growing recurring revenue while ensuring a smooth, transparent experience at every contract touchpoint. You'll engage customers well ahead of renewal, lead pricing and commercial discussions, negotiate complex agreements, and proactively address risk so customers can continue to rely on GitLab's DevSecOps platform without disruption. In this quota-carrying role within the Renewals team, you'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Product to forecast outcomes, reduce churn, and uncover expansion opportunities. In your first year, you'll be focused on building strong relationships with key stakeholders in your accounts, consistently delivering on-time renewals, and contributing to scalable renewal processes that support GitLab's long-term growth.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end renewal lifecycle for an assigned portfolio of customer contracts, from early engagement through signed agreement.
  • Develop and execute account-level renewal strategies that protect recurring revenue and reduce customer churn.
  • Prepare renewal proposals, pricing quotes, and contract documentation in line with customer needs and internal guidelines.
  • Lead commercial and contractual negotiations with customer stakeholders, managing pricing discussions, terms, and timelines.
  • Identify and qualify opportunities to expand footprint through upsell and cross-sell in partnership with Sales and Customer Success.
  • Monitor customer health, usage, and satisfaction signals to surface at-risk renewals early and drive mitigation plans.
  • Maintain accurate renewal pipeline, forecasts, and activity tracking in CRM and related systems to enable clear reporting and planning.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Product teams to remove obstacles, align on strategy, and ensure timely, smooth renewals.

What you'll bring

  • Fluency in Portuguese and Spanish
  • Experience owning an end-to-end renewal motion for subscription or SaaS contracts, including forecasting, negotiation, and closing.
  • Background in B2B subscription-based businesses with a track record of meeting or exceeding renewal and retention goals.
  • Skill in managing a portfolio of renewal accounts at scale while prioritizing high-impact opportunities and risks.
  • Proficiency working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot, along with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for analysis and reporting.
  • Ability to build productive relationships with customer stakeholders, navigate complex procurement processes, and lead commercial discussions.
  • Experience partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to structure renewals, address adoption gaps, and manage contract terms.
  • Strength in identifying renewal risks early, using customer health and usage data, and developing practical mitigation plans.
  • Openness to learning GitLab's platform and processes, with transferable skills welcomed from renewals, account management, sales, or customer success roles.

About the team

The Renewals team focuses on protecting and growing GitLab's recurring revenue by managing the full contract lifecycle for our subscription customers. As a Renewal Manager, you'll be part of a quota-carrying team that works closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to ensure timely, accurate renewals and strong customer retention across regions in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. The team is responsible for forecasting renewal outcomes, identifying and addressing churn risk, and uncovering opportunities to expand GitLab adoption, while continuously improving processes and best practices that support predictable, sustainable growth.

About Frontier

Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully-remote, 380-person company that has most of our team in India and the Philippines. A few years ago Fresh Prints started helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we decided to spin out a new company to focus exclusively on that and call it Frontier.

Here at Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people, and we place them in the best companies. We have placed over 800 hires across 50 different US-based startups and high-growth companies.

About the Client

Pavus is a a fast-growing, founder-led AI company in the procurement technology space, often described as "Palantir for procurement." Currently in an active deployment phase, the company onboards enterprise clients and runs real-world sourcing events through a lean deployment team that blends tactical execution with customer advisory work.

About the Role

The Operations Specialist serves as the execution core for the data and supplier-coordination layer that keeps the platform delivering for enterprise customers. Day-to-day, this role focuses heavily on Excel-based data work—cleaning, structuring, and validating supplier, product, and quantity datasets ~ while supporting live sourcing events and vendor outreach so senior team members can remain focused on high-level strategy. Success in this role means owning a client account end-to-end within 90 days, running back-end operations and communication independently.

Key Responsibilities

Data Cleaning & Validation

  • Clean, structure, and validate supplier, product, and quantity data using Microsoft Excel.

  • Apply VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX MATCH, pivot tables, and conditional formulas to organize and normalize datasets.

  • Sanity-check data for missing values, inconsistent formatting, and errors prior to modeling, comparing extracted data against source documents.

  • Build structured, replicable, formula-driven Excel models without hard-coded values.

  • Onboard validated customer data onto the client's deployment platform.

Deployment & Operations Support

  • Maintain and update supplier and product records across active sourcing events.

  • Conduct outbound phone calls to US-based suppliers, vendors, or business contacts as needed to coordinate sourcing details.

  • Support end-to-end deployment of sourcing events for enterprise customers.

  • Proactively flag process gaps and recommend operational improvements.

  • Take on expanded end-to-end account ownership as tenure and performance progress.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on Microsoft Excel experience in a professional work environment (excluding coursework or training), with strong proficiency in pivot tables, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX MATCH, and IF formulas.

  • Demonstrated experience cleaning, normalizing, and validating datasets using formula-based methods (no hard-coded values) and building replicable models others can follow.

  • Experience conducting outbound phone calls to US-based suppliers, vendors, or business contacts in a professional capacity.

  • C1+ English proficiency (CEFR), both spoken and written, with strong attention to detail.

  • Located in Latin America and able to work full-time aligned to US Eastern Time (Monday–Friday, within ±1 hour of New York time, including an 8:45 AM ET daily team standup).

  • Nice-to-Have: 1–2 years of experience in management consulting or at a boutique advisory firm, hands-on procurement or supply chain experience, prior exposure to e-procurement/sourcing platforms, or Python skills for data manipulation and automation.
