jobs.jobDescription:
Who We Are:

Xenon Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:XENE) is a neuroscience-focused biopharmaceutical company dedicated to drug discovery, clinical development, and commercialization of life-changing therapeutics for patients in need. We are looking for great people who thrive in a respectful, collaborative, inclusive, and productive culture to join the Xenon team.

What We Do:

We are advancing an exciting product pipeline to address indications with high unmet medical need, including epilepsy, depression and pain. Our Phase 3 azetukalner program represents the most advanced, clinically validated potassium channel modulator in late-stage clinical development for multiple indications. In March 2026, we announced positive topline data from our Phase 3 X-TOLE2 study of azetukalner in focal onset seizures (FOS), and we submitted a New Drug Application to the Food and Drug Administration in the third quarter of 2026. Our Phase 3 epilepsy program also includes a second FOS study, X-TOLE3, which would support regulatory submissions outside the U.S., and the X-ACKT study in primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures, which would support regulatory submissions for an additional epilepsy indication. We also have multiple Phase 3 azetukalner clinical trials underway in major depressive disorder (MDD) and bipolar depression (BPD), based on topline data from our Phase 2 X-NOVA clinical trial. In addition, we are proud of our strong heritage in human genetics, deep understanding of ion channel biology, and expertise in novel chemistries to enable potent, selective ion channel targeting. We continue to advance an early-stage pipeline of novel therapeutic candidates, including Phase 1 studies for XEN1701 and XEN1720 (targeting Nav1.7) and XEN1120 (targeting Kv7), which are being developed for pain. Backed by a strong balance sheet to support our growth plans, we continue to build a fully integrated, premier neuroscience company with strong discovery, clinical development, corporate, and commercial operations.

About the Role:

We are seeking a dynamic, patient-centric, strategic, collaborative, agile, and results-oriented Executive Business Director (EBD), Epilepsy to lead our West region. This leader will be responsible for leading and developing a team of Regional Sales Managers and ensuring successful execution of Xenon's commercial strategy across a multi-state geography. Reporting to the Vice President, Sales, the ABD serves as the senior field leader within the assigned area and is accountable for launch readiness, business performance, leadership development, field effectiveness, and cross-functional execution.

As Xenon prepares for its first commercial launch, the ABD will play a critical role in building the field organization, developing frontline leadership capabilities, establishing performance expectations, and ensuring consistent execution across all regions. The ABD serves as the key link between national commercial strategy and field execution, translating corporate priorities into actionable plans while fostering collaboration across the field and cross-functional partners.

Success in this role requires exceptional leadership, launch expertise, strategic business acumen, strong cross-functional influence, and the ability to build and scale high-performing teams in a dynamic and evolving commercial environment.

This position reports to the VP, Sales and will be fully remote.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Leadership of Leaders

  • Build and maintain a high-performing team of Regional Sales Managers.

  • Establish consistent leadership expectations, performance standards, coaching practices, and operating rhythms across the area.

  • Coach and develop Regional Sales Managers in leadership effectiveness, business planning, strategic account management, and organizational leadership.

  • Ensure Regional Sales Managers effectively recruit, onboard, develop, and retain high-performing field teams.

  • Conduct talent reviews, succession planning, development discussions, and performance management activities.

  • Foster an ethical, inclusive, and patient-focused culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.

Launch Readiness & Commercial Execution

  • Lead launch readiness activities across all regions within the assigned area.

  • Monitor readiness milestones and proactively identify risks, capability gaps, dependencies, and resource needs.

  • Partner with Regional Sales Managers to ensure launch plans are executed effectively and consistently.

  • Support field deployment planning, territory readiness, customer engagement preparation, and adoption of commercial systems and processes.

  • Translate national commercial priorities into aligned regional execution plans.

  • Provide field perspectives and recommendations to the Vice President of Sales and Commercial Leadership Team regarding launch readiness and business opportunities.

Business Performance & Field Effectiveness

  • Drive achievement of area business objectives and commercial priorities.

  • Lead area business reviews and performance discussions to assess regional trends and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Monitor business performance through leading and lagging indicators and implement actions to address performance gaps.

  • Ensure consistency in customer engagement, account planning, coaching effectiveness, CRM utilization, and execution standards across regions.

  • Ensure collaboration with internal partners and regional sales managers to improve productivity, resource allocation, and organizational effectiveness.

  • Identify and share best practices across the area to drive continuous improvement and execution excellence.

Strategic Account Leadership & Market Insights

  • Provide leadership and support for key epilepsy centers, academic institutions, health systems, integrated delivery networks, and other strategic accounts spanning multiple regions.

  • During the pre-launch phase, develop relationships with key accounts across assigned regions to support launch readiness and future customer engagement.

  • Support Regional Sales Managers in navigating complex customer, health system, and access-related opportunities and challenges.

  • Aggregate and synthesize field insights across the area to identify emerging customer needs, patient journey barriers, treatment trends, competitive developments, and market opportunities.

  • Ensure field perspectives are incorporated into commercial planning, customer engagement strategies, and business decision-making.

  • Communicate actionable recommendations and market intelligence to the Vice President of Sales and Commercial Leadership Team.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the senior field leader for cross-functional initiatives impacting the assigned area.

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Commercial Operations, Commercial Training, Analytics, Human Resources, Legal, and Compliance.

  • Ensure alignment around launch plans, customer engagement activities, business priorities, and field execution.

  • Facilitate communication and collaboration between field teams and headquarters functions.

  • Support coordinated resolution of business issues affecting multiple regions and customers.

  • Promote transparency, accountability, and shared ownership across the organization.

Compliance, Culture & Resource Management

  • Model Xenon's values of collaboration, ambition, resilience, ethical and science driven

  • Ensure all field activities comply with company policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements.

  • Promote a culture of ethical leadership, compliance, and responsible decision-making.

  • Oversee area budgets, resource allocation, travel, meetings, and commercial investments.

  • Ensure Regional Sales Managers maintain strong compliance standards within their teams.

  • Foster an environment where employees feel empowered, supported, engaged, and accountable.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.

  • 12+ years of biotechnology or pharmaceutical commercial experience.

  • 7+ years of progressive commercial or sales leadership experience.

  • Significant biotechnology or pharmaceutical launch experience required.

  • Experience leading first-line sales leaders required; second-line leadership experience strongly preferred.

  • Neurology experience required; epilepsy experience strongly preferred.

  • Proven success building, developing, and leading high-performing organizations and leadership teams.

  • Strong experience working with academic institutions, epilepsy centers, health systems, integrated delivery networks, and specialty markets.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence and lead within complex matrix organizations.

  • Strong strategic thinking, business planning, analytical, coaching, and organizational leadership capabilities.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and cross-functional leadership skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM platforms, analytics tools, and Microsoft 365 applications.

  • Ability to travel up to 75%.

  • Develop and propose short- and long-term objectives for the function in accordance with overall Company strategies and plans

  • Plan and manage budget proposals and approved budgets in accordance with the Company’s strategic and operating plans and Finance policies

  • Recruit, lead, direct, develop, coach and evaluate direct reports, if any, in accordance with the Company’s Human Resource policies and practices

  • Act in accordance with Company policies, including, for example, the Code of Business Conduct and Ethics and ensure policies are understood and followed by direct reports, if any

  • Some international travel may be required

Other duties as assigned

Our Total Rewards program includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options, as well as a full range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, short-& long-term disability, accidental death & dismemberment, and life insurance programs, Employee Assistance Program, travel insurance, and retirement savings programs with company matching contributions.

Xenon encourages time to rest and re-charge through vacation, personal days, sick days, and an end-of-year company shutdown. Xenon highly values employee development and has an expanding Training, Learning & Development program, including a Tuition Assistance program for advanced degrees.

jobs.jobDescription:
As a Senior Performance Strategist at Superside, you'll own how the work performs in market: what runs, how it's tested and how it keeps getting better. This is a strategy role, not a media-buying role. You'll be a senior strategic partner to enterprise clients and our creative leaders: advising on performance creative, shaping new solutions, and spotting opportunities for ongoing optimisation and account growth. You'll work alongside our creative strategists, creative teams and product team, using evidence to turn great ideas into results for global brands.

What You'll Do

  • Bring performance data and past results into every brief, so strategy starts from what people actually do.
  • Lead performance-focused projects, finding the opportunity in the data and briefing creative teams.
  • Turn campaign ideas into in-market plans across channels, formats and audiences.
  • Design testing roadmaps and measurement frameworks, and set up tests and tracking.
  • Analyse creative performance to show what's working, what isn't and why.
  • Optimise creative in market, scaling what works and moving people through the funnel.
  • Turn results into clear recommendations on what to scale, cut and try next.
  • Advise senior client stakeholders as a trusted strategic partner, presenting results and recommendations with confidence.
  • Identify opportunities to grow accounts, from ongoing optimisation programs to new performance offerings.
  • Incorporate an AI-native mindset across the whole strategic process.
  • Partner with our product team to invent and build new performance creative solutions, workflows and offerings that scale across clients and studios, going beyond applying existing tools.
  • Share learnings and help shape how performance and creative strategy work together.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • 7+ years in performance or growth strategy at an agency or brand, with a focus on performance creative.
  • Experience independently leading complex performance strategy engagements and influencing senior client stakeholders and creative leaders.
  • A track record of designing and running creative testing programs that improved results.
  • Strong analytical skills across major ad platforms, with a working grasp of attribution and measurement.
  • Full-funnel experience across paid social, acquisition and conversion.
  • The ability to find creative opportunities in data and write briefs creative teams want to run with.
  • A belief that brand and performance work best together.
  • Genuine curiosity about emerging technology and experience experimenting with or building new workflows.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience working directly with senior clients.
  • Curiosity, collaboration and a commitment to growing your strategic craft.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.

Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.

Global team, local impact.

Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.

High performance, low ego.

Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.

Impact meets opportunity.

We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.

Grow fast. Lead well.

You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension

of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance.

Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

Learn more at superside.com

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

jobs.jobDescription:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit https://mineralystx.com. Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Regional Sales Director

The Regional Sales Director (RSD) will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned region. This leader will be accountable for translating national strategy into regional execution, driving business performance through strong field leadership, cross-functional partnership, and disciplined execution against launch objectives.

The RSD will build and lead a high-performing team of territory managers, foster deep customer relationships, and ensure alignment with corporate priorities, compliance standards, and Mineralys’ values. This is a highly visible field leadership role requiring strong business acumen, launch experience, and the ability to lead with urgency in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership / Launch Execution

  • Lead all regional launch planning and execution activities to ensure successful market entry and sustained product uptake
  • Translate national brand strategy into actionable regional business plans and field execution priorities
  • Lead team to achieve or exceed sales goals, market share targets, and key performance metrics at launch and beyond
  • Monitor market dynamics, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to adjust strategy in real time
  • Drive accountability for performance through data-driven decision making and disciplined execution

Team Leadership / Coaching

  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain top-performing territory managers across the region
  • Lead, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 8–12 territory managers
  • Establish and maintain high level of disease state, clinical and product knowledge
  • Evaluate performance of territory managers and coach to skill and career development through regular field contact
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Build strong succession plans and talent pipelines

Customer / Market Engagement

  • Develop and maintain relationships with key healthcare providers, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and strategic accounts
  • Partner with territory managers on key customer interactions, access challenges, and develop account strategies
  • Support pull-through with IDNs, organized customers, and priority accounts
  • timely and effectively sharing of customer insights with internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Training, Operations, and HR to support launch readiness and execution
  • Provide field-driven input into brand planning, messaging, and tactical adjustments
  • Collaborate with Area Sales Directors and peers to share best practices and drive consistency across regions
  • Support national meetings, launch planning sessions, and field communications

Compliance / Operational Excellence

  • Ensure all regional activities are conducted in full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and legal standards
  • Manage regional budgets and resources effectively
  • Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM utilization, and reporting discipline
  • Uphold Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech sales experience
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience in a district / regional manager role
  • Proven success leading specialty sales teams and exceeding performance goals
  • Prior launch experience required; first-launch / startup biotech experience strongly preferred
  • Experience in cardiovascular, nephrology, hypertension, or related specialty markets strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated success in recruiting and developing top talent
  • Strong business planning, analytical, and coaching skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment
  • Willingness to travel extensively within region

Leadership Profile

  • A strong coach who develops people and builds winning teams
  • Highly accountable, with a bias for action and urgency
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping build infrastructure
  • Collaborative and able to influence across functions
  • Resilient, adaptable, and energized by launch environments

Travel

  • This position requires up to 60% travel. Frequently travel is outside the local area and overnight.

These positions are eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

US Salary Range: $210,000-$235,000

A Little About Us

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com

**Candidate Note: This position is 100% remote for candidates based in US**

We're looking for a Staff Engineer that will focus on a Database Platform that supports Postgres estates and fleets. This position owns the packaging and delivery of a number of Kubernetes operators, across the supported cloud Kubernetes environments (EKS, AKS, GKE, OpenShift/RHOS, kind). The work spans Kubernetes packaging, container builds and CI/CD, Postgres-on-Kubernetes infrastructure, and the customer documentation for those capabilities, and it contributes to database release readiness for each release cycle. You will be part of a supportive team with a breadth of experience.

What you will be doing:

  • Solving problems for customers by developing easy-to-use systems and features for EDB’s database platform offering(s).
  • Leveraging cloud environments to scale our development, testing, and build systems
  • Improving the performance and usability of existing products, features, and automated systems
  • Collaborating and mentor engineers on a global distributed team to ensure we are using standard methodologies to build scalable, secure, and operationally sound tools and systems.
  • Documenting and evangelizing products, features for use by engineers for the development, testing, and packaging of their products
  • Implementing and maintaining Kubernetes operators
  • Must be able to independently take a feature from design to implementation, delivering according to release dates and deadlines. Working across different development teams in order to ensure cross dependency.
  • Developing distributed systems for Kubernetes environments
  • Technical writing for customer-facing product documentation that is passed to the documentation team, and documentation for internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to present technical explanations to engineering audiences and internal stakeholders in English.

What you will bring:

  • Hands-on experience authoring Kubernetes Operators.
  • Expert in Golang (Go).
  • Deep Kubernetes experience, both managed (e.g. Cloud) and self-managed (e.g. OpenShift, Rancher)
  • Container build tooling: Docker, multi-stage and CI image builds.
  • Traditional enterprise networking patterns and best practices.
  • Ability to manage work in a globally distributed remote environment.

What will set you apart:

  • Familiar with OpenShift, familiar for design systems for OpenShift / RHOS packaging and Red Hat certification.
  • Appliance or cloud-marketplace delivery, including air-gapped and private-registry install scenarios.
  • IAM, Object Storage, Cloud Storage
  • Observability for Postgres workloads.
  • CI/CD with GitHub Actions; infrastructure-as-code and config management; linting (hadolint, pre-commit).
  • Using CloudNativePG or comparable Postgres operators, with solid Postgres operational knowledge.
  • High-availability and distributed systems.

EDB is committed to supporting our employees' overall well being by offering a range of benefits and resources to promote a healthy work-life balance and wellness. We provide access to CuraLinc to aid employees in health and wellness tips and practices, as well as Wellness Fridays extending to December 2026! Check out our career site for more information on perks and benefits and reach out to our Talent Acquisition team for region specific benefits.

We know it takes a unique mix of people and skills to help us in our mission to supercharge Postgres, and we understand that not everyone will check every box. We’d love to hear from you and we want you to apply!

EDB is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. EDB was built on a commitment to trust and respect each other and to embrace an array of people and ideas. These values remain at the center of our culture and are key to our company’s integrity.

EDB does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. EDB and its affiliates are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other similar payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written signed agreement between EDB and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

  • During the pre-launch phase, develop relationships with key accounts across assigned regions to support launch readiness and future customer engagement.

  • Support Regional Sales Managers in navigating complex customer, health system, and access-related opportunities and challenges.

  • Aggregate and synthesize field insights across the area to identify emerging customer needs, patient journey barriers, treatment trends, competitive developments, and market opportunities.

  • Ensure field perspectives are incorporated into commercial planning, customer engagement strategies, and business decision-making.

  • Communicate actionable recommendations and market intelligence to the Vice President of Sales and Commercial Leadership Team.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the senior field leader for cross-functional initiatives impacting the assigned area.

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Commercial Operations, Commercial Training, Analytics, Human Resources, Legal, and Compliance.

  • Ensure alignment around launch plans, customer engagement activities, business priorities, and field execution.

  • Facilitate communication and collaboration between field teams and headquarters functions.

  • Support coordinated resolution of business issues affecting multiple regions and customers.

  • Promote transparency, accountability, and shared ownership across the organization.

Compliance, Culture & Resource Management

  • Model Xenon's values of collaboration, ambition, resilience, ethical and science driven

  • Ensure all field activities comply with company policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements.

  • Promote a culture of ethical leadership, compliance, and responsible decision-making.

  • Oversee area budgets, resource allocation, travel, meetings, and commercial investments.

  • Ensure Regional Sales Managers maintain strong compliance standards within their teams.

  • Foster an environment where employees feel empowered, supported, engaged, and accountable.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.

  • 10+ years of biotechnology or pharmaceutical commercial experience.

  • 7+ years of progressive commercial or sales leadership experience.

  • Significant biotechnology or pharmaceutical launch experience required.

  • Experience leading first-line sales leaders required; second-line leadership experience strongly preferred.

  • Neurology experience required; epilepsy experience strongly preferred.

  • Proven success building, developing, and leading high-performing organizations and leadership teams.

  • Strong experience working with academic institutions, epilepsy centers, health systems, integrated delivery networks, and specialty markets.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence and lead within complex matrix organizations.

  • Strong strategic thinking, business planning, analytical, coaching, and organizational leadership capabilities.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and cross-functional leadership skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM platforms, analytics tools, and Microsoft 365 applications.

  • Ability to travel up to 75%.

  • Develop and propose short- and long-term objectives for the function in accordance with overall Company strategies and plans

  • Plan and manage budget proposals and approved budgets in accordance with the Company’s strategic and operating plans and Finance policies

  • Recruit, lead, direct, develop, coach and evaluate direct reports, if any, in accordance with the Company’s Human Resource policies and practices

  • Act in accordance with Company policies, including, for example, the Code of Business Conduct and Ethics and ensure policies are understood and followed by direct reports, if any

  • Some international travel may be required

  • Other duties as assigned

Our Total Rewards program includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options, as well as a full range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, short-& long-term disability, accidental death & dismemberment, and life insurance programs, Employee Assistance Program, travel insurance, and retirement savings programs with company matching contributions.

Xenon encourages time to rest and re-charge through vacation, personal days, sick days, and an end-of-year company shutdown. Xenon highly values employee development and has an expanding Training, Learning & Development program, including a Tuition Assistance program for advanced degrees.

jobs.jobDescription:
Beyond powers the business of short-term rentals with a best-in-class Revenue Management System used by thousands of property managers and owners around the world. We’re profitable, growing fast, and building with the latest technologies—including AI—to help our customers unlock more revenue with less effort. Behind our product is a global team of 180+ Beyonders who bring curiosity, craft, and care to everything we do. We believe people are the most important part of any business, starting with ours.

It is with that in mind that Beyond is looking for a Client Revenue Manager to join our growing team. Reporting to our Senior Manager of Professional Services, you will have the opportunity to manage our customers who need an outsourced revenue manager as part of our Guidance offering. As a Client Revenue Manager, you will play a pivotal role in delivering white glove customer experience. The role will also provide cross-functional business exposure to the Revenue Management team. You will work to ensure that these customers are successful and long lasting customers of Beyond to allow us to maintain our foothold as the market leader in this industry. As the world and travel landscape shift around us, so too do the needs of our customers, and this role plays a key component in ensuring that they not only survive but thrive in this environment.

Before reading further…

Beyond is passionate about diversity and cultivating our team’s potential. If you’re hungry for a good opportunity, but don't meet every point in this job description, please apply anyway!

As our Client Revenue Manager, you’ll be responsible for:

  • Ensuring our customer’s success by analyzing how they can maximize revenue.
  • Serve as their revenue manager and utilize Beyond to review booking data and charts to make pricing decisions
  • Providing ad-hoc analyses on booking trends and pricing performance for clients
  • Building relationships with customers by driving value using a consultative approach to become an influencer and trusted extension of their team
  • Managing approximately 20-30 accounts and drive value to retain clients
  • Negotiating annual subscription renewals and upsell opportunities
  • Reviewing Beyond’s algorithm performance in existing markets, making actionable recommendations based on data driven insights
  • Partnering closely with the Revenue Management, Sales, Product and Customer Experience Teams
  • Utilizing strong interpersonal skills to listen while communicating clearly and effectively with clients so they understand the why behind our rates and best practices
  • Providing proactive support and service

So what kind of person are we looking for in this role? The person who will be successful in this role will:

  • Have deep customer-empathy: you find fulfillment in helping customers reach their goals.
  • Enjoy working with people: you are driven to provide an excellent customer experience.
  • Be data-minded: you are exceptional with data and leveraging it to make strategic decisions.
  • Go above and beyond: you pride yourself on going above and beyond for teammates and customers.
  • Be Highly Analytical: you are able to look at multiple graphs and charts and instantly derive insight

Now that we’ve told you what the job looks like, here are the qualifications we're looking for in a candidate:

  • At least 2 years of experience working in a client-facing role (customer success, account management, sales, etc.)
  • At least 2 years of Revenue Management Experience in a Hospitality or an equivalent industry
  • Experience working with software or ability to learn a wide variety of tools for data analysis, including comfort with data sets in excel.
  • Succinctly explain the “why” behind data-driven decisions
  • Experience helping customers through presentations, trainings, or day-today questions

So what can you expect after you apply? Your application will be personally reviewed by a member of the Beyond hiring team and if you seem like a good addition to our team, you will:

  • Have a video conversation with someone on our Recruiting team. This is a high-level conversation about your experience and interest, but also an opportunity for you to learn more about us
  • Meet with our Manager of Professional Services for a deeper dive video conversation
  • Complete an assignment relevant to the role and meet with a few additional members of the Customer Experience team
  • Meet with our Vice President of Customer Experience or General Manager

Company Values:

We are serious about our core values: We Care, We Are On the Same Team, We Inspire Trust, We Go Beyond, We Ship It, We're Curious. If those resonate with you, and you're ready to work with a team that lives and breathes those values, we want to hear from you.

Benefits:

Beyond offers a wide variety of benefits like: stock options, unlimited PTO, private health insurance and more! You can learn more about our benefits by visiting our careers site!

We Care about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion:

Beyond is committed to building a workplace that attracts humans of all genders, ethnicities, backgrounds, statuses and lifestyles. At our core, we care about our people and encourage every employee, partner and applicant to share their whole self with us. We are respectful of and empathetic towards different viewpoints, and believe that our ability to help short term rental managers succeed relies on us building a dynamic and diverse team. Whoever you are, you can Belong @ Beyond.

AI Policy:

At Beyond, We Inspire Trust. In each other, in our process, and in the people we bring onto the team. As part of that commitment, we’re implementing clear guidelines around the use of AI in our recruitment processes. Please review the full policy here.

Any communication regarding job openings, interviews and/or offers will come from our @beyondpricing.com email domain

Please review our GDPR Statement here.

jobs.jobDescription:
Flex is building AI-native financial services for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About the Role

We're seeking an ambitious problem solver with a record of achievement on an exponential trajectory.

As City Manager, you'll lead Flex's growth in New York. You know the business owners, the culture, and which rooms matter. Your job is to turn that into new Flex customers.

You'll build a target list of 50 business owners you'd most like to bring to Flex. From that list, you'll identify five North Star accounts; the high-priority relationships that could have a meaningful impact on Flex's growth and visibility in your market.

Your job is to develop a strategy for reaching those owners, building relationships, and ultimately bringing their businesses onto Flex. Some opportunities will move quickly, while others will take time. You'll also build relationships within their networks, creating additional opportunities for customer acquisition.

You'll take ownership of these relationships from the first conversation through conversion, working with our sales and industry teams to move opportunities forward.

You'll work closely with teams across Flex, including sales, finance, marketing, operations, and leadership, plus City Managers in other markets. Your city is yours to run, with a team behind you.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own the city’s dream list of 50 owners, prioritizing five North Star accounts and identifying the best path to each.
  • Curate rooms built around the people on your list: Plan and host events that bring the right people together, including intimate dinners, customer gatherings, and strategic brand activations.
  • Develop relationships with prospective customers and guide them from initial conversations through account opening, staying involved as their businesses grow with Flex.
  • Evaluate and negotiate sponsorships and memberships, and only say yes to the ones that put you in front of people on the list.
  • Develop a monthly market plan covering your priority accounts, upcoming initiatives, and progress toward customer acquisition.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to move opportunities forward, generate customer referrals, and share insights from your market.
  • Maintain an organized pipeline, track applications and referrals, coordinate events, and manage your local budget.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: Your 50 are written, your five are picked, your first rooms have happened and you’re in real conversations with your North Star accounts.

First year: Your North Star accounts are on Flex, the customers you brought in are active and spending, and people around the city are sending you introductions without being asked.

Above all, we care about results: accounts closed and how they use Flex once they’re open. Plenty of great customers will come from outside your list, and those count too.

Requirements

  • Strong relationships with your city’s business owners. You could write the dream list this week and say how you know each person on it.
  • A track record in sales or business development, in financial services, private banking, real estate, hospitality, membership clubs, or another relationship-driven business. You’re comfortable asking for the business and closing.
  • A pulse on your city: the restaurant everyone’s talking about this month, the best rooftop, where to take someone for a serious cocktail. People trust your taste.
  • An eye for design: venue, event flow, how a space photographs, and the details, like menu cards and table settings, that make something memorable.
  • The ability to spot the right opportunities, build a strategy to pursue them, and stay organized throughout.
  • A competitive streak, and the judgment to know when bringing in a teammate helps close the deal. You make calls the way the CEO of Flex would, with the company’s interest first.
  • Currently based in LA.

Nice to Haves

  • Bilingual skills, which may be preferred or required depending on the market.

Compensation

Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Additional Information

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.

Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.

High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.

Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.

Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

Superside is looking for a Lead Creative (Motion Design) to push the boundaries of what’s possible in motion and animation.

In this role, you’ll lead a global team of top-tier creatives, delivering world-class motion graphics, digital ads, explainer videos, promos, animated presentations, and more. You’ll shape creative strategy, inspire your team, and partner with leading global brands to deliver impactful work that blends craft, innovation, and cutting-edge technology.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and inspire a team of motion designers, driving creative excellence and innovation across projects.
  • Own the creative strategy, workflow, and delivery of multiple projects, ensuring quality, timeliness, and budget alignment.
  • Collaborate with your dedicated account teams to successfully grow and develop our customers
  • Partner directly with global brands, presenting work and building trust through outstanding creative direction.
  • Mentor and develop your team, fostering growth, skill development, and collaboration.
  • Champion the adoption of new tools and technologies, including AI, to elevate motion design processes and outputs.

What you will need to succeed

  • BA or higher within Design, Creative, Comms, or similar fields.
  • 6+ years of experience as a world-class creative lead in an international top-tier creative agency or in-house design team in a global tech company
  • Strong portfolio of creative work in Motion Design.
  • Experience leading high-performing creative teams, managing end-to-end creative projects.
  • Deep expertise in Adobe After Effects and Premiere; strong animation and video editing skills.
  • Solid understanding of AI-assisted design and motion workflows (e.g. MidJourney, Runway, Krea etc), with a track record of integrating AI tools into creative pipelines to enhance ideation, production, and delivery.
  • Ability to quickly learn processes and multi-task projects with great detail.
  • Ability to always deliver pixel-perfect quality on time and within budget
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.
  • A proactive, customer-centric mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.

Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.

Global team, local impact.

Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.

High performance, low ego.

Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.

Impact meets opportunity.

We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.

Grow fast. Lead well.

You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension

of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance.

Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

Learn more at superside.com

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

jobs.jobDescription:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit https://mineralystx.com. Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Regional Sales Director

The Regional Sales Director (RSD) will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned region. This leader will be accountable for translating national strategy into regional execution, driving business performance through strong field leadership, cross-functional partnership, and disciplined execution against launch objectives.

The RSD will build and lead a high-performing team of territory managers, foster deep customer relationships, and ensure alignment with corporate priorities, compliance standards, and Mineralys’ values. This is a highly visible field leadership role requiring strong business acumen, launch experience, and the ability to lead with urgency in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership / Launch Execution

  • Lead all regional launch planning and execution activities to ensure successful market entry and sustained product uptake
  • Translate national brand strategy into actionable regional business plans and field execution priorities
  • Lead team to achieve or exceed sales goals, market share targets, and key performance metrics at launch and beyond
  • Monitor market dynamics, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to adjust strategy in real time
  • Drive accountability for performance through data-driven decision making and disciplined execution

Team Leadership / Coaching

  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain top-performing territory managers across the region
  • Lead, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 8–12 territory managers
  • Establish and maintain high level of disease state, clinical and product knowledge
  • Evaluate performance of territory managers and coach to skill and career development through regular field contact
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Build strong succession plans and talent pipelines

Customer / Market Engagement

  • Develop and maintain relationships with key healthcare providers, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and strategic accounts
  • Partner with territory managers on key customer interactions, access challenges, and develop account strategies
  • Support pull-through with IDNs, organized customers, and priority accounts
  • timely and effectively sharing of customer insights with internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Training, Operations, and HR to support launch readiness and execution
  • Provide field-driven input into brand planning, messaging, and tactical adjustments
  • Collaborate with Area Sales Directors and peers to share best practices and drive consistency across regions
  • Support national meetings, launch planning sessions, and field communications

Compliance / Operational Excellence

  • Ensure all regional activities are conducted in full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and legal standards
  • Manage regional budgets and resources effectively
  • Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM utilization, and reporting discipline
  • Uphold Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech sales experience
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience in a district / regional manager role
  • Proven success leading specialty sales teams and exceeding performance goals
  • Prior launch experience required; first-launch / startup biotech experience strongly preferred
  • Experience in cardiovascular, nephrology, hypertension, or related specialty markets strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated success in recruiting and developing top talent
  • Strong business planning, analytical, and coaching skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment
  • Willingness to travel extensively within region

Leadership Profile

  • A strong coach who develops people and builds winning teams
  • Highly accountable, with a bias for action and urgency
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping build infrastructure
  • Collaborative and able to influence across functions
  • Resilient, adaptable, and energized by launch environments

Travel

  • This position requires up to 60% travel. Frequently travel is outside the local area and overnight.

These positions are eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

US Salary Range: $210,000-$235,000

jobs.jobDescription:
About Sayari:

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

Forward Deployed Engineer II

The Role

Sayari’s largest customers, the biggest government agencies and Fortune 100 companies, are moving from data products to an agentic platform that runs their investigation and risk workflows end to end. As a Forward Deployed Engineer II, you are dedicated to those accounts. You own the technical win (demo, proof of concept, trial), then the deployment, then what comes after. The same engineer scopes the problem and ships it.

You are equal parts engineer, strategist, and operator. You embed in the customer’s environment, build on Sayari’s agentic platform against their data and their workflows, and solve high-stakes problems that have no textbook answers. You are the conduit between the front lines and core engineering: what you learn in the field becomes what the platform does next.

What You’ll Do

  • Win the technical evaluation: design and run demos, proofs of concept, and trials that prove the platform on the customer’s own data. Define success criteria with the customer and hit them.
  • Deploy the agentic platform: build agents, tools, and integrations on Sayari’s agentic platform inside the customer’s environment, and take them from trial to production.
  • Embed and build: ship production Python, SQL, and integrations into customer persistence layers and analytics stacks.
  • Own the relationship: serve as the primary technical authority for the account. Brief executives, analysts, and mission owners on outcomes.
  • Triage and feed engineering: decide what is bespoke, what is reusable, and what belongs in the platform. Document capability gaps and drive them into the roadmap.
  • Raise the bar: set delivery standards and review work for other engineers on your accounts.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years in a client-facing technical role (forward deployed engineering, sales engineering, or technical consulting).
  • 7-8+ total years of experience working in software engineering and/or solutions consulting
  • A record of owning strategic deployments end to end, from technical win to production.
  • Production Python, including the data manipulation ecosystem (Pandas). Deep experience having worked with SQL. Hands-on experience integrating and reasoning about REST APIs.
  • Building and deploying on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) with containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • You are a technology polyglot, you have worked across multiple tech stacks and enjoy getting the opportunity to navigate different coding languages, frameworks, and systems.
  • AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude, or similar) as a daily part of how you work.
  • Executive communication. You articulate technical concepts with clarity and conviction to engineers, analysts, and senior leaders alike.
  • Problem solving in ambiguity, and the drive to parachute into new environments and learn new technologies on the fly.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field.

Desired

  • Hands-on experience building agentic or LLM systems: orchestration, tool use, retrieval, evaluation.
  • Sovereign, air-gapped, or government cloud deployments.
  • Modern data stack (Snowflake, Databricks) and workflow orchestrators (Airflow, Prefect).
  • Graph data technologies and their query languages.
  • Exposure to ML, NLP, or entity resolution.
  • Experience in high-stakes domains: AML and financial crime, supply chain risk, or national security.

How You Work

You operate with extreme ownership. You build the bridge rather than flag the gap. You prefer a working prototype to a slide about one. You can scrap a month of work when the mission changes without losing momentum, and you hold yourself accountable for the outcome, not the activity.

Logistics

  • Travel and in-office time: 25 to 30% combined.
  • Limitless growth and learning opportunities.

Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

Pay Range

$160,000—$180,000 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Director, Product Marketing

Location: Remote US

Compensation Range: $190,000 to $210,000 base plus bonus and equity

What You’ll Do:

You will own the go-to-market story for Huntress's MSP business, turning product capabilities, SOC expertise, and community insight into a clear narrative that helps MSPs evaluate, sell, bundle, and grow with Huntress. You will make the work of Product, Campaigns, Sales, Community, and Security land with the people who depend on it. Give More Than We Take by creating practical value for every team and partner you touch, from a sharper message architecture to enablement that helps a seller have a better first conversation.

You are Candor in action when you bring the MSP voice into roadmap, launch, and campaign decisions, making the hard tradeoffs visible and the feedback useful. You are Outcome-Obsessed about the results: stronger new-logo demand, better pipeline quality, higher multi-product attach, and more productive sellers. You will move from insight to action quickly, learn from the field, and keep improving the motion as MSP needs and the market change.

Responsibilities:

  • Own MSP-level positioning, value propositions, message architecture, and proof points that give every product story a clear place in the way MSPs buy and grow.
  • Partner with Campaigns and Growth Marketing to turn audience insight into demand programs and mid-funnel and bottom-funnel assets, including buyer guides, comparison content, business-case tools, demo narratives, and webinars.
  • Build cross-sell and attach plays that help MSPs expand across Huntress products, including practical bundle, pricing, margin, and seller workflow guidance.
  • Turn SOC incidents, threat research, analyst expertise, and response outcomes into credible MSP-facing proof, while partnering with Community on practitioner education, events, and peer programs.
  • Represent MSP needs in product launches and roadmap conversations, and equip SDRs, AEs, and Partner and Channel Account Managers with talk tracks, discovery questions, objection handling, competitive guidance, and first-call decks.

About the Role

Vantage is hiring a Staff Engineer. You help set technical strategy across teams and deliver it through direct implementation, broad technical leadership, or both.

As a Staff Engineer, you drive the technical roadmap multiple teams build against, and you're accountable for it landing. You influence peers and senior leadership to get behind it. You clear cross-team dependencies before integration points turn into delays or crunch, and you build the frameworks and processes teams use to stay aligned without needing you in the room.

You stay hands-on, leading several significant initiatives in parallel. Your depth spans the whole stack, frontend through data, and you use that breadth to define SLAs and observability standards. You own technical debt management and give technical direction that balances what we need to ship this quarter against what we need to still be true in three years.

You raise the bar of the whole engineering team through mentorship, design review, and pairing

Minimum Requirements

  • 9+ years of professional experience with a strong record in software development, testing, software design, and architecture.

  • Very deep knowledge of a full production stack: frontend, backend, infrastructure, and data. You can explain how a choice in one layer shows up as a problem in another, and you design accordingly.

  • Track record of owning a multi-quarter technical roadmap that spanned more than one team, including securing buy-in from engineering peers and senior leadership and driving it to completion.

  • Experience managing technical debt as an explicit program of work: quantifying it, prioritizing it, making the business and developer-experience case to leadership, and landing it in a roadmap alongside product commitments.

  • Experience designing and operating B2B API integrations: authentication, rate limiting, retries, idempotency, versioning, and contract evolution.

  • Track record of mentoring senior engineers, not just junior ones, including through architectural thinking and not only code review.

  • Experience with CI tooling, Docker, and cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

  • Experience evaluating and rolling out developer tooling, including AI-assisted development tools, with a clear view of where they earn their keep and where they introduce risk to code quality, review discipline, or data handling.

  • Deep Python and Django experience building production services

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and implementation of multiple significant technical initiatives in parallel, staying hands-on in the code and the architecture.

  • Provide technical direction that balances short-term delivery against long-term sustainability, and make sure architectural decisions across teams remain consistent over time.

  • Own technical debt management. Surface the debt that matters, build the case for it in business and developer-experience terms, take it to leadership, and work with Product to get it prioritized in quarterly goals.

  • Use forums such as Architecture Office Hours, Lunch and Learns, internal talks, and the wiki to spread context, enforce industry best practices, and keep teams aligned to the technical roadmap.

  • Mentor engineers across the department, including senior engineers, in partnership with their managers. Create growth opportunities for others rather than absorbing the interesting work yourself.

  • Act as a quality gatekeeper through active code review and testing strategy, and deliberately enable other engineers to become effective reviewers and gatekeepers themselves.

Vantage is the first unified platform purpose-built for retail media orchestration, empowering enterprise retailers to seamlessly activate onsite, offsite, and in-store advertising. Remote-First, Based in Toronto

About Sayari:

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

About the Role

Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do.

The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard.

You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. You sit in the same org as Forward Deployed Engineers and the Product team. The field shapes the roadmap, and Product sets it.

Why This Role Exists

  • Customers buy answers. Superconductor reasons like an expert analyst at machine scale. The analyst’s job shifts from producing every answer by hand to directing, validating, and extending what Superconductor produces, and teaching customer analysts to do the same.
  • Context should survive the contract. The analyst who designed the proof-of-value knows why the success criteria are what they are. Keeping that analyst on the account protects delivery quality and surfaces the next problem before the customer names it.
  • Tradecraft is built in the field. Field Intelligence Analysts see what was promised, what was delivered, and what the customer did with it. That full view produces better methodology, better evals, and a better Superconductor than any single-phase role can.

What You Will Do

Own the analytical relationship, end to end

  • Run discovery and proof-of-value engagements anchored on work the customer already pays people to do, such as alert adjudication, due diligence, investigations, and case prioritization. Define success criteria you will personally be accountable for delivering.
  • Stay on the account after close and deliver the work you scoped. This includes multi-hop investigations across ownership, trade, and corporate records, plus analytical briefings and training.
  • Serve as the customer’s single analytical point of contact from first conversation through renewal.

Build with Field Engineering and Product

  • Pair with FDEs on discovery and delivery. You define the analytical requirement, they build it, and you validate it against the mission.
  • When something built for one customer should be rebuilt for many, make the case to Product with evidence: the problem, the workaround, and the customers who share it.
  • Document where the platform falls short of the mission, with raw examples attached.

Deliver analyst-plus-AI, and teach it

  • Direct Superconductor against live mission problems. Validate its reasoning against expert standards, and extend it into new customer workflows.
  • Train and certify customer analysts on Sayari methods and on working with Superconductor. Identify the customer experts who should go further.

Build the tradecraft

  • Capture the judgment calls, non-obvious pivots, and creative approaches from live engagements. Contribute them to the Tradecraft team as expert-annotated reference cases, eval scenarios, and training material.
  • Hold your work to the Field Intelligence standard, and help raise it.

Support Go-To-Market Teams

  • Work with Sales to diagnose customer problems, scope solutions, and deliver mission impact.

Who You Are

Required

  • A builder’s temperament and comfort with ambiguity. You do well on small teams with end-to-end ownership and no defined lane, working next to engineers on things that don’t exist yet.
  • Experience conducting complex, multi-source investigations in one or more of these areas: financial crime, sanctions and export controls, supply chain and forced labor risk, transnational criminal organizations, or law enforcement and intelligence investigations. This should include work with corporate records, trade data, and OSINT.
  • Customer-facing range. You have scoped engagements, demonstrated capability to skeptical experts, and delivered under a statement of work. Candidates often come from solutions consulting, services delivery, embedded analytics, or mission-support roles.
  • Hands-on fluency directing and evaluating AI and agentic analytical tools. You can define what “right” looks like precisely enough to test against.
  • Clear communication with analysts, program managers, engineers, and executives.

Desired

  • Python or SQL for data manipulation, and familiarity with REST APIs.
  • Experience designing training curricula or certifying analysts.
  • For government portfolios: an active Government security clearance and same citizenship as your country of residence.

Compensation

The target base salary for this position is $100,000 - $162,000 plus variable bonus and equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, candidate experience-levels and expertise, internal peer equity, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Benefits:

  • 100% fully paid medical, vision, and dental for employees and their dependents
  • Generous time off; we observe all US federal holidays, close our office for a winter break (12/24-12/31), in addition to granting 18 PTO days and 10 sick days
  • Outstanding compensation package; competitive commissions for revenue roles and bonuses for non-revenue positions
  • A strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Eligibility to participate in additional benefits such as 401k match up to 5%, 100% paid life insurance (up to $100,000 coverage), and parental leave
  • A collaborative and positive culture - your team will be as smart and driven as you
  • Limitless growth and learning opportunities

Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

You take that work the last mile, creating next-level narratives, new content, and enablement that resonate with your segment so that marketing, sales, and channel partners can have more relevant conversations and close more business, faster.

You are Outcome-Obsessed, connecting messaging, enablement, and demand programs to measurable business results. You bring Perfect Imperfection to research and go-to-market work by acting on useful insight, learning quickly, and sharpening the IIS motion each quarter. Candor guides how you work across teams, giving you the confidence to make recommendations, hold a point of view, and push back constructively.

Responsibilities:

  • Own IIS segment positioning, value propositions, message architecture, proof points, and a repeatable bill of materials across the personas and key industries of your segment.
  • Conduct ongoing research and analysis to improve the IIS motion, including representing the voice of IIS buyers and their needs in product launch and roadmap conversations.
  • Partner with Product Marketing peers to adapt portfolio and platform content for IIS audiences and key industries.
  • Partner with Campaigns and Growth Marketing to turn audience insight into demand programs, nurture streams, outreach, livestreams, buyer guides, verticalized content, comparison content, business-case tools, demo narratives, and other mid- and bottom-funnel assets.

  • Use AI to orchestrate repeatable workflows for market and buyer analysis, research, and content development, thoughtfully validating outputs for accuracy, relevance, and quality.

What You Bring To The Team:

  • You have 6+ years of product marketing experience, including 3+ years in B2B cybersecurity software, with measurable results you can show.
  • You have experience marketing and selling to in-house IT and security buyers, with experience serving small and midsized businesses preferred.
  • You bring a buyer-centric mindset and naturally frame messages around pain points, buying triggers, personas, decision-making, and outcomes.

  • You have partnered hands-on with Campaigns or Growth Marketing teams to create programs, nurture streams, and content that contributed to pipeline.
  • You have experience working with sales and channel partners, including VARs and distributors.
  • You collaborate effectively, hold a clear point of view, balance competing stakeholders, push back constructively, and move comfortably between strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You can orchestrate AI-supported workflows for research, analysis, and writing, while applying sound judgment to validate and improve the output.

  • Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays

  • 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution
