jobs.jobDescription:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About the role

We’re looking for an Experiential Marketing Manager to produce the real-world experiences where traders, creators, partners, and builders meet MetaMask. You’ll lead production, help shape event strategy, and sharpen the creative execution.

What You’ll Do

You’ll join the Experiential & Global Events team within MetaMask’s Creative Studio and report to the Director of Experiential Marketing. We concept, design, and produce the ways people meet MetaMask in real life across global conferences, community events, VIP experiences, co-branded activations, and more. Our calendar runs across the world with priorities across APAC, the US, Europe and LATAM.

You’ll lead production, taking each event from brief to on-site to recap. You’ll work cross-functionally with internal and external teams, rallying people from planning through production and on the ground. Your focus will be experiences for our most active users and co-branded work with brands and creators, alongside community events for the builders who create on MetaMask.

Our formats are expanding to include live trading competitions, viewing events, product launches, and private experiences for VIP traders and creator partners.

How You’ll Do It

  • Produce events and experiences end to end: venues, run of show, fabrication, AV, F&B, and staffing, working alongside our production agency partners.
  • Own timelines, workback plans, and budgets for multiple events running in parallel across regions.
  • Source, negotiate with, and manage agencies, venues, and vendors in APAC, the US, Europe and LATAM.
  • Run registration and guest management, from guest lists and approvals to VIP access and arrival.
  • Build programming for events and panels, including formats, session flow, and speaker coordination.
  • Keep the operational side tight: source-of-truth docs, trackers, internal team staffing, and on-the-ground comms during conference weeks. Build playbooks that make each event easier to run than the last, using AI tools to move faster.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams across product, marketing, business development and more to turn briefs into event plans with clear audiences, objectives, and success metrics tied to product and business goals.
  • Help develop and refine concepts with the creative team. Bring a point of view on formats, venues, and cultural trends, and work with designers and copywriters on decks and creative deliverables.
  • Work with content capture teams so every event produces strong stories and shareable content.
  • Track post-event results, including attendance, registration data, and social reach and sentiment, and write recaps that show what worked and what to change.
  • Over time, help source and manage co-hosts and sponsors for our owned franchises.

We’re looking for someone with

  • 5+ years in event production, experiential marketing, or brand activations, ideally in fintech, crypto, consumer tech, esports, or entertainment.
  • Experience producing large-format or competitive live events, such as tournaments, launches, or live viewing events.
  • A track record of delivering multi-city or international events on time and on budget.
  • Experience managing agencies and vendors and negotiating contracts under tight deadlines.
  • Experience producing premium or invite-only experiences for high-value guests.
  • Strong initiative. You spot what needs to happen and do it before anyone asks, and you stay steady when the plan changes.
  • Strategic and creative judgment. You connect an event to a product or business goal, and you bring ideas that sharpen a concept.
  • A systems mindset. You turn one-off events into repeatable processes.
  • Clear, confident communication with stakeholders at every level, including senior leadership. Partners, vendors, and colleagues want to work with you again.
  • Based in the US or EU, and willing to travel internationally up to 20% of the year, typically 1 to 2 weeks per quarter across several markets.
  • Curiosity about money, markets, and how people trade, save, and spend. Finance experience isn’t required, but interest is.

It’s a bonus to have

  • Experience in crypto, whether producing events for digital asset audiences or at global conferences such as Token2049, Korea Blockchain Week, EthCC, or Devcon.
  • Experience sourcing or managing event co-hosts and sponsors.
  • Relationships with brands, creators, or communities that could become MetaMask partners.
  • An existing network of production vendors, agencies, and venues across multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with tools like Notion, Slack, and Luma.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.

US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)

$101,000—$141,000 USD

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

MetaMask is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself, which can be found on our page.

MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI.

It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants may be required to submit to background and identity verification checks, including but not limited to employment, education, criminal record checks, and other such checks as determined necessary by the company.

jobs.jobDescription:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The JavaScript team at Mozilla works to make Firefox's industry-leading JavaScript engine SpiderMonkey even more performant. We push the boundaries of what the web is capable of, shaping the future of the JavaScript language through standardization at TC39, while keeping in mind the fundamental principle of “don’t break the web.”

As a Staff Software Engineer on the SpiderMonkey team, you'll be a domain expert who drives the engine's runtime performance forward, from the interpreter and JITs to the garbage collector, while also helping maintain and advance the health of a large, mature C++ codebase. You'll typically lead performance projects within the team, planning the work and mitigating the risk yourself, and you'll mentor other engineers as you take on increasingly ambiguous, high-impact problems.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead runtime performance initiatives: Own projects to improve SpiderMonkey's runtime performance, from profiling and identifying bottlenecks to designing and landing optimizations across the interpreter, JITs, and garbage collector.
  • Provide technical leadership to the team: Mitigate risk for the performance projects you own, planning work that may start out ambiguous and require significant up-front design and prototyping.
  • Maintain and advance the codebase: Help preserve the correctness and stability of a large, mature C++ codebase while improving its architecture and maintainability as the JavaScript language and the engine continue to evolve.
  • Track and shape the JavaScript standard: Work with the JavaScript team to keep up with the evolving TC39 standard, and help evaluate proposals where performance or implementation tradeoffs are involved.
  • Strengthen engine security: Collaborate with the Fuzzing team to identify and close security issues in the JavaScript engine.
  • Mentor and elevate the team: Mentor other engineers by stewarding some of your existing responsibilities to more junior team members as you take on new, larger initiatives, and help the team build stronger performance-analysis and benchmarking practices.
  • Communicate clearly: Turn team strategy and goals into concrete action for the projects you lead, and communicate progress, tradeoffs, and technical decisions clearly to your team and to partner teams.
  • Use AI tools day to day: Incorporate AI-assisted tools into your workflow for debugging, prototyping, code analysis, and development.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years developing C++ applications
  • Demonstrated expertise in systems programming, including direct experience with one or more of: compilers, garbage collectors, interpreters, and virtual machines
  • Strong background in performance analysis, profiling, and benchmarking on large and complex software
  • Experience with general systems architecture (x86, x64, ARM, ARM64, etc.)
  • A track record of technical leadership: planning ambiguous projects, sequencing project work, and mitigating risk with minimal help
  • Experience mentoring other engineers and helping raise a team's technical standards
  • Creative problem solver with strong debugging skills and a detailed approach to code review
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable turning team strategy into action and communicating tradeoffs to peers
  • Comfortable incorporating AI assisted tools into your day-to-day engineering workflow

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days when everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program

jobs.jobDescription:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a SMB Account Executive to our Client Sales team in Italy! Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Italy.

As an SMB Account Executive, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating the expansion of our team and business across Italy. You will be responsible for autonomously managing a robust pipeline of inbound and outbound prospects within the SMB segment (up to 500 employees), driving high-velocity sales cycles, and bringing the mission of Wellhub to organizations throughout the country.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead and execute end-to-end sales cycles autonomously, qualifying and converting inbound opportunities and outbound Sales Development outreach into active deals.
  • Manage and accelerate high-volume pipeline activities across phone, video meetings, email, and social selling to swiftly secure demos and advance prospective clients.
  • Drive complex deals forward through effective multi-threading, overcoming objections, and executing seamless closings within the SMB market (up to 500 employees).
  • Consistently achieve and exceed quarterly sales quotas while maintaining high operational discipline and revenue growth.
  • Leverage performance metrics and data alongside your manager and team to continuously refine sales strategy, conversion rates, and pipeline health.
  • Thrive and adapt within a fast-evolving, high-velocity environment, pairing a competitive drive to win with strong collaboration and team spirit.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A seasoned sales closer with at least 3+ years of full-cycle sales experience, demonstrating a consistent track record of driving and closing revenue.
  • A proven high-velocity seller with prior experience in SaaS solutions and/or selling directly to HR stakeholders (experience within high-velocity environments or the fitness/wellness industry is strongly preferred).
  • An exceptional communicator and active listener who connects effortlessly with prospects and internal partners through charismatic, high-energy engagement.
  • An ambitious self-starter who operates with tenacity, optimism, and an intrinsic drive to hit and exceed ambitious targets.
  • An adaptable and coachable professional who embraces change, seeks constructive feedback, and balances individual excellence with collaborative team success.
  • A mission-aligned advocate who brings genuine enthusiasm for helping people build healthier, happier, and more balanced lives.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in full-cycle B2B Sales and SaaS or HR stakeholder solution selling are mandatory requirements.

Compensation is governed by the CCNL per i dipendenti da aziende del Terziario, della Distribuzione e dei Servizi ("Commercio") - collective bargaining agreement (CBA). The role is classified at Livello II. The gross salary range for this position is 2,945 €/monthly to 4,418 €/monthly . The annual salary includes the standard base pay components defined by the CBA (Art. 206), as well as the 13th-month salary paid in December (Art. 220) and the 14th-month salary paid in July (Art. 221), for a total of 14 monthly payments. The annual salary range shown is based on a full-time, 40-hour workweek (Art. 130). Monthly salary is paid at the end of each month in line with our regular payroll cycle. In addition to base salary, this role is also eligible for variable cash compensation, which is either our annual bonus plan or a sales incentive plan, and/or our performance-based stock option program.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.jobDescription:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

Grafana Labs is looking for a Commercial Account Executive, Growth based in Germany who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across DACH. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals
  • Outbound prospecting into net-new customers
  • Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations)
  • Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads
  • Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise
  • Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce
  • Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 2+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales
  • Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)
  • Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player
  • Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies
  • You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually
  • Fluent in English & German

Bonus Points For:

  • Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage
  • Experience using Salesforce
  • Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal

Compensation & Rewards

In Germany, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 175,000 - EUR 185,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

jobs.jobDescription:
WorkWave is a leading provider of SaaS solutions, helping businesses streamline their operations and drive growth through innovative technology. As we continue to expand, we are looking for an experienced Implementation Specialist to join our Global Professional Services team. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting our ongoing SaaS client implementations and software integrations—working alongside our senior product leads and implementation team to drive project delivery, manage data migration and mapping tasks, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and provide project management support across active client go-lives.

Operating as a critical member of our APAC delivery team, you will serve as the engine powering project execution. While our core product leads oversee deep system configuration, you will ensure data flows accurately between systems, test integration workflows, keep stakeholders aligned, and deliver a smooth, high-trust customer onboarding experience.

This role demands an exceptional blend of analytical accuracy, clear communication, and calm composure under competing priorities. You will bring structure and momentum to active implementations, ensuring every client transitions smoothly into live operation. This role is based in Melbourne, Australia, reporting to the Head of Professional Services.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Technical Consultancy & Implementation: Deliver high-quality technical consultancy and implementation services in line with the contract and Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring a consistently positive customer experience.

  • Data Migration & Integration Validation: Manage data preparation, mapping, and migration activities while executing UAT and test scenarios to confirm solutions and integrations perform accurately prior to go-live.

  • Implementation & Configuration Support: Partner with senior implementation leads to execute project tasks, software configuration, and system validation across active client deployments.

  • Project Governance & Risk Tracking: Track implementation progress alongside project leads, complete stage-gate task lists within agreed SLAs, and proactively highlight risks or issues that could impact delivery timelines.

  • Customer Enablement & Adoption: Communicate clearly with clients regarding project requirements, delivering hands-on training and guiding them through business process improvements and technology adoption.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success colleagues to ensure seamless project handovers, smooth onboarding, and timely escalation of commercial expansion opportunities.

  • Product Mastery & Standards: Maintain strong working knowledge of WorkWave products, delivery methodologies, and company policies, representing WorkWave professionally at all times.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Implementation Experience: 2+ years of experience conducting software implementations within a SaaS environment, with a strong grasp of data migration, mapping, and UAT workflows.

  • Client Training & Enablement: Proven ability to train clients on new software platforms and updated operational processes.

  • Domain & System Familiarity: Experience with Finance, Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and/or Payroll systems is advantageous, as is familiarity with the Cleaning, Facilities Management, or Security industries.

  • Stakeholder & Priority Management: Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder expectations and conflicting priorities while maintaining perspective, accuracy, and composure.

  • Situational & Commercial Awareness: Strong judgment to escalate delivery risks appropriately to management and spot additional commercial opportunities during client engagements.

  • Communication & Professionalism: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a commitment to high standards of professional conduct and teamwork.

  • Education: A Bachelor’s degree in IT or a business-related field is desirable (no specific licences or certifications required).

Compensation

Additional Information

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US:

  • Laid back, but high-performing: We offer a casual work environment, remote flexibility, and a commitment to building innovative, best-in-class solutions that drive customer success.

  • Customer-focused: We deliver software and services that make a measurable difference to our clients and their businesses.

  • Inclusive and collaborative: We build partnerships based on mutual trust, shared goals, and open communication.

  • Curious and driven: Our team values proactive problem-solvers who want to make an impact while enjoying what they do.

LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT:

  • Remote-First Global Community: WorkWave connects talent worldwide with a modern remote-first culture. You get the stability and reach of an established global platform combined with the autonomy, innovation, and direct impact of a scale-up.

A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE:

  • True Workplace Flexibility: We support modern work/life balance. Whether collaborating virtually or meeting up face-to-face, our teams are fully equipped to deliver high-impact results remotely across Australia.

  • Global Footprint: Headquartered at the Bell Works campus in New Jersey (USA), we have team members across North America, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.

  • Connected Culture: Regardless of location, every team member joins an inclusive network committed to supporting each other, delivering great software, and engaging with our local communities.

REWARD & WELLBEING:

In addition to statutory superannuation (guaranteed at the current legislated rate) and standard National Employment Standards (NES) leave—such as 4 weeks of annual leave and 10 days of personal/carer’s leave—we provide:

  • 5 additional days of Flexible Wellness Leave per year

  • Enhanced Parental Leave scheme

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for confidential mental health, wellbeing, and lifestyle support

  • Paid Community Volunteer Days

  • Global & Local Perk Schemes: Personal travel discounts and employee shopping discount programs

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

WorkWave is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a safe, inclusive, and diverse work environment. We adhere to the Australian Fair Work Act 2009, the Sex Discrimination Act, the Disability Discrimination Act, and Victoria’s Equal Opportunity Act 2010.

All employment decisions are based on merit, competence, and business needs, without regard to age, race, cultural or ethnic background, religion or belief, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, disability status, marital or parental status, or any other protected attribute under Commonwealth and Victorian law.

Studies show that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds—including women, First Nations people, and neurodivergent individuals—often hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If you are excited about this role and feel your transferable skills could add value, we strongly encourage you to submit your application.

If you require reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please inform our Talent Acquisition team.

WORK RIGHTS & REMUNERATION TRANSPARENCY

  • Work Rights: Applicants must hold current, unrestricted working rights for Australia (Australian Citizenship, Permanent Residency, or a valid work visa with no work-hour limitations). Proof of working rights (e.g., VEVO check or passport) may be requested during the recruitment process.

  • Salary Estimates: Automated salary estimates generated by third-party job boards (such as SEEK, LinkedIn, or Glassdoor) are not set by WorkWave and may not reflect the actual package for this role. Competitive packages are discussed transparently with candidates based on experience and market benchmarks.

PRIVACY & APPLICANT DATA

By submitting your application, you consent to WorkWave collecting, holding, and using your personal information for recruitment and talent acquisition purposes in accordance with the Australian Privacy Principles and our Privacy Policy . If your application is unsuccessful, we may retain your profile to contact you regarding future opportunities that match your background. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal details at any time. https://www.workwave.com/privacy-policy.

AssetWatch powers manufacturing uptime by delivering an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal.

We are growing FAST and seeking a Field Coordination Manager to lead our real-time field support and escalation function. This role is responsible for ensuring seamless execution of field operations by rapidly resolving issues, supporting field teams, and protecting the customer experience.

WHO YOU ARE:

You thrive in fast-paced, high-pressure environments where no two days are the same

You are highly responsive and take pride in solving problems quickly and effectively

You are deeply customer-focused and see every issue as an opportunity to deliver excellence

You communicate with clarity, urgency, and empathy

You are a natural problem solver who can think on your feet

You are energized by supporting others and removing obstacles to success

You are comfortable jumping into any situation and taking ownership

You are a strong leader who can coach and develop a team in a dynamic environment

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Own all real-time field support and escalation management

Act as the primary point of contact for urgent scheduling conflicts and field issues

Rapidly resolve issues such as technician availability, customer escalations, and schedule disruptions

Coordinate with Scheduling to adjust plans as needed while minimizing impact

Serve as the bridge between field teams, customers, and internal stakeholders during live operations

Ensure clear and timely communication across all stakeholders during issues

Monitor and improve time-to-resolution for field-related issues

Support field technicians with resources, information, and coordination needs

Identify recurring issues and partner with Scheduling to drive long-term solutions

Lead, coach, and develop a team focused on high-quality support execution

Maintain strong relationships with customers and internal teams

Support system and process improvements that enhance field visibility and responsiveness

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

2+ years of experience in customer support, field operations, or coordination roles

Experience managing high-volume support environments

Experience leading or coaching teams

Strong communication and problem-solving skills

Experience with CRM and support tools (Salesforce preferred)

DESIRED SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Ability to remain calm and effective under pressure

Strong prioritization and decision-making abilities

Empathy and customer-first mindset

Highly adaptable and responsive

Strong collaboration skills across teams

KPI OWNERSHIP:

  • Time-to-resolution
  • Customer experience / CSAT
  • Field morale
  • Escalation resolution effectiveness

jobs.jobDescription:
Overview

CoinTracker is on a mission to unlock everyone's financial potential so they can build the life they want. We started with crypto, building the tax and portfolio tools that millions of users trust to trade digital assets with peace of mind. Nino builds the next layer of financial fluency for our users. Nino is an AI-powered financial operating system that makes comprehensive, expert-level tax and financial planning advice accessible.

More on Nino: Comprehensive tax and financial planning strategies are currently locked behind high AUM fees or require enough wealth to have a family office. We are turning expert judgment into software so we can serve millions. AI is going to redefine how people understand their finances and how tax advice gets delivered. Not in ten years, in 2026. You can help define that, or spend the next few years adapting to rules someone else wrote. Nino sits inside CoinTracker ($100M raised, partnered with Coinbase, TurboTax, H&R Block, and Thomson Reuters) with the autonomy of an early-stage startup and the reach of an established platform.

Your mission

As Product Engineer, you'll own customer problems from the first conversation to a working product. You'll talk to users, shape the idea, design the experience, and build it across the stack. You'll work closely with engineers, design, and our CPAs and Financial Planners to turn complicated financial work into software people can understand and trust.

Your one-year outcomes

  • Customers rely on what you build. You've shipped meaningful features end to end, with evidence that customers use them and find them valuable.

  • More financial work gets done. Workflows you own help households and advisors complete tasks with less manual effort, fewer handoffs, and clearer next steps.

  • The experience holds up. Your features are easy to use and reliable in practice, including when information is missing, an integration fails, or a person needs to step in.

  • We learn and ship faster. You turn ambiguous problems into focused releases, learn from real usage, and use that evidence to decide what to improve next.

What you will do

  • Examples of what you could build:

    • Trading: Help users go from an investment idea to a reviewed trade, with clear approvals, execution status, and visibility into what happened.

    • Strategies: Build ways to discover financial ideas, understand their upside and tradeoffs, explore how they fit a household's situation, and turn a saved strategy into a plan of action.

    • Tax filing: Bring document collection, missing-information requests, CPA review, and filing progress into one clear experience for households and their tax team.

    Across these features, you'll:

    • Own problems from discovery to launch. Talk with customers and financial experts, identify what matters, and decide what to build first.

    • Design the experience. Sketch, prototype, and refine interfaces with our designer. Make complex decisions and workflows feel clear.

    • Build across the stack. Ship interfaces, backend services, integrations, and AI workflows. Follow the problem wherever the implementation takes you.

    • Turn agents into useful products. Build ways for people to understand, review, and approve an agent's work, including workflows that span external tools and websites.

    • Make the whole flow work. Handle incomplete information, interruptions, retries, and human handoffs. Verify that the task actually finished correctly.

    • Use AI tools to ship and iterate. Move quickly, understand and check what you ship, and keep improving it through customer feedback and usage.

What we look for

  • Role-agnostic

    • Opportunity alignment: You want to help households manage complex finances and bring expert tax and financial planning to more people. You're excited to shape a product on a small, early team.

    • High agency: You see what needs doing and take responsibility for it. You can start with an incomplete brief, find the missing information, and make progress.

    • Exceptional collaboration: You make the people around you better: engineers, designers, CPAs, and Financial Planners. You seek feedback, say what you think, and follow through.

    • First-principles thinking: You start with the customer's problem, question assumptions, and can explain why your approach makes sense. You change your mind when the evidence changes.

  • Role-specific

    • Strong engineering fundamentals. You've built and shipped working software, can reason through unfamiliar systems, and care about correctness and maintainability.

    • Product judgment. You can turn an open-ended problem into a useful first release, explain what you left out, and define how you'll know it helped.

    • Design taste. You notice confusing interactions, care about the details, and can explain how your changes improve the experience.

    • You ship your own work. You're comfortable moving between the interface and backend, using AI coding tools thoughtfully, and verifying the result.

    • Bonus: startup, agent, or integration experience. You've built directly with users, worked with browser automation or AI agents, or connected systems that don't fit neatly together.

Prior experience with finance, AI or ML products, or our exact tech stack isn't required. Neither is a particular degree or school. We're interested in what you've built and how you think.

The starting salary for this position is between $140,250 - $207,775 USD. Candidate's location does not impact the posted salary range. The actual compensation offered will be based on a variety of job-related factors including relevant skills, education, and experience. This position also includes equity in CoinTracker and benefits like medical, dental, vision, 401(k), life insurance, and PTO.

jobs.jobDescription:
At WorkWave, we build innovative software and fintech solutions for the people who keep our world safe, clean, and beautiful, from pest control to lawn care, commercial cleaning to security services. With over 8,000 customers around the globe, our platform helps these hardworking service professionals run and grow their businesses from end to end: from customer acquisition to scheduling, billing, payments, and beyond.

Our vision is simple but powerful: empower the world’s mobile service workers to build a brighter future. And we back that up with decades of experience, a passionate team, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers thrive.

WorkWave is seeking a results‑driven Account Executive to focus on small and growing Pest and Lawn service businesses. This role is ideal for a motivated sales professional who is eager to build strong relationships, master a consultative sales process, and help entrepreneurs transform the way they run and grow their service businesses.

Why Join Now:

We’re at an exciting moment in our growth journey. With the launch of Wavelytics, our new AI-powered analytics suite, and continued momentum in integrated payments, we’re unlocking new ways to deliver value to our customers, and new opportunities for our team. WorkWave operates in a field service management market that’s accelerating due to global trends in automation, sustainability, and digital transformation. Joining now means getting in early as we scale to meet massive demand and lead the future of service software.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Learn quickly and build a strong understanding of our platform and its value for small, growing Pest and Lawn service businesses with 4-9 employees
  • Lead online demos that excite and inspire stakeholders to envision a future state that drives growth, efficiency, and digital transformation
  • Own your territory like a “CEO”. Manage the sales cycle from lead generation to closing with a hunter mentality that balances a consistent cadence of outbound activity and a quick response to inbound MQLs
  • Master the sales process - conducting discovery, scoping, and proof of concept to create a seamless experience for prospects
  • Leverage best‑in‑class tools like Salesforce, SalesLoft, and 6Sense to manage activity, build accurate forecasts, and a strong predictable pipeline
  • Stay focused on results - hitting weekly KPIs (demos booked, demos held, 3x pipeline) and closing deals every week to exceed quota

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • The ability to take initiative and work independently, confidently manage your pipeline, prospect proactively, lead demos that inspire, and close deals efficiently
  • Strong communication skills that combine active listening, thoughtful negotiation, and consultative selling to connect with and influence stakeholders
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple deals at once and manage quick turnarounds without missing a beat
  • A positive, can-do attitude with a natural talent for building authentic relationships and earning trust quickly
  • 1-3 years of experience in a closing sales role within SMB markets
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a SaaS SMB Account Executive role
  • Must be within a commutable distance to our Holmdel, NJ office

Compensation

In our dedication to salary transparency, we provide a compensation range for sales roles, which is $65,000 in addition to uncapped commission. The final offer will be dependent on various factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and the organization's budget. Our Talent Acquisition team will provide more information about the compensation package for this position during the interview process.

Additional Information

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US:

• We are laid back but buttoned up. We offer a casual work environment and remote work flexibility and have a passion for developing creative, innovative best in class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers

• We care deeply and deliver service and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses

• We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust

• Teamwork and collaboration is key to help our colleagues and customers solve their challenges

• Our team is energetic, fun, naturally inquisitive and eager to make an impact, we invite you to join us!

LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT:

• Join our Remote-First Global Work Community: WorkWave provides an innovative and dynamic remote-first Global Work Community that encourages growth, creativity, and collaboration. No matter what stage of your career or where you live, WorkWave is your place to be part of a global company with a startup feel, where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority.

A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE:

• We know that there are benefits of being in the office and working from home. WorkWave promotes a healthy work/life balance and provides employees with the flexibility of collaborating in the office or the option to work virtually if desired. Our teams are well versed at working collaboratively in a fully virtual environment.

• Our HQ is based at our state of the art home office in the historic Bell Works complex located in Holmdel Township, New Jersey. We keep our offices available to all to use when working remotely isn’t feasible, or to help with cross training, team building and/or brainstorming.

• We have employees in over 30 states, 7 countries and many regional offices - each with their own set of perks and opportunities to give back to the local community.

• Whether you work remotely or take advantage of one of our offices, you’ll find a community of WorkWavers that value diversity, and care deeply about our products, clients, our communities and each other.

RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED:

• Employees can expect a robust benefits package, including health and dental and 401k with company match

AND BEYOND...

• Find your perfect work/life balance with our Flexible Time Off policy or generous PTO plan (role dependent) and paid holidays

• Up to 4 weeks paid bonding leave

• Tuition reimbursement

• Robust Employee Assistance Program through TotalCare offering free counseling 24/7/365, plus financial counseling, legal guidance, adoption assistance services and much more!

• 24/7 access to virtual medical care with Teladoc

• Quarterly awards based on peer nominations

• Regional discounts and perks

• Opportunities to participate in charitable events and give back to the community

GROW WITH US:

• We understand the impact of attracting and keeping top talent and reward intellectual curiosity and a thirst for personal and professional growth

• Encouraging our employees that already have an intimate knowledge of and passion for our products to apply for other roles within our walls just makes sense!

• Our employees have access to extensive video libraries for soft skill and role specific training available 24/7 and live trainings are provided throughout the year

JOIN OUR WINNING TEAM!

• 10 Time winner of Best Place to Work in New Jersey by NJBiz!

• WorkWave has been recognized with multiple awards for its outstanding products, growth and culture, including the Inc. 5000, SaaS Award, IT World Awards, Globe Awards, Silver Stevie Award for Employer of the Year, and Best Place to Work Inc. Magazine

• Recently named one of The Software Report's 3rd annual list of the Top 100 Software Companies of 2022 (worldwide!)

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status: Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At WorkWave, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you feel like you could make a great impact in this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

WorkWave supports salary transparency, however please note that salary estimates provided by websites (LinkedIn, Glassdoor, etc.) and not by WorkWave may not accurately reflect the actual salary range for the position.

jobs.jobDescription:
AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal – To build the future of predictive maintenance. As we enter the next phase of rapid growth, we are seeking people to help lead the journey.

AssetWatch powers manufacturing uptime through condition monitoring that customers rely on every day. Our team of world-renowned engineers and business leaders is building the future of predictive maintenance, and we are growing fast.

The Director of Customer Support builds, scales, and leads AssetWatch's support organization, delivering fast, technically excellent help to manufacturing customers. This leader directs 20 or more support managers, team leads, and engineers across time zones, drives down resolution times, and embeds AI-powered tooling.

The Director will also lead the reorganization of support into two specialized teams: Tier 1 for the inbound queue and live calls, and Tier 2 for deeper, project-managed work, including root-cause resolution of chronic hardware issues. The team focuses on hardware support, and its work directly influences product uptime in the field.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy and Team Leadership

  • Lead the Tier 1 and Tier 2 support teams through the reorganization.
  • Create clear performance standards and hold teams accountable to them through regular quality reviews and coaching.
  • Build performance metrics and frameworks for individuals and teams. Co-own the annual operating plan and headcount planning.
  • Set annual and quarterly support goals that cascade into team and individual objectives, and review progress with the executive team each quarter.
  • Define the team operating model, including span of control, shift coverage, and staffing levels, and update it as volume and product lines grow.
  • Run a leadership development program for Team Leads and Managers covering coaching, decision-making, and cross-functional communication.

Operations, Quality, and Hardware Outcomes

  • Own support quality and customer effort. Reduce repeat contacts and ticket volume per device or account.
  • Lead escalations for Sev 1 incidents and strategic accounts and hold executive incident reviews.
  • Maintain visibility into at-risk tickets, outages, and field hardware or sensor failures, and act on early warnings before customers escalate.
  • Reduce recurring hardware issues by leading root-cause investigations with hardware, engineering, and field teams.
  • Design processes, playbooks, and SOPs. Keep the knowledge base current and ramp new hires to full productivity within 30 days.
  • Evolve the support tech stack (ticketing, knowledge base, remote diagnostics) and integrate it with CS, sales, and product systems, sequenced against the product roadmap.

AI, Product, and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead AI integration: 100% tool adoption and 20%+ agent productivity gain within 18 months. Champion triage, diagnostics, self-service, and agent-assist tools.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between support and Product and Engineering, turning frontline insights and recurring issues into reliability roadmap priorities.
  • Present quarterly support health metrics to executives, with monthly ticket trend data and recommended actions.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations on handoffs and at-risk account signals.
  • Lead support strategy for Mexico and Latin America, including localized language support and follow-the-sun coverage. Maintain 100% compliance with local labor and data privacy rules.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 8+ years in customer or technical support, including B2B SaaS or hardware-enabled SaaS. 4+ years in director-level leadership managing 15+ people across multiple supervisory levels. 2+ years directly accountable for SLA, CSAT, or quality metrics.
  • Industry: 3+ years in SaaS, HaaS, IoT, predictive maintenance, manufacturing, or similar technical B2B sectors strongly preferred. Understanding of incident management and hardware or software troubleshooting in connected devices.
  • Leadership: Proven track record building high-performing support organizations, recruiting, developing leaders, and creating accountability.
  • Strategic execution: Measurable gains in CSAT, SLA compliance, resolution time, and first contact resolution.
  • Global experience: 2+ years leading remote, shift-based, or follow-the-sun teams. Mexico or Latin America experience highly valued.
  • Technical and AI fluency: Comfort with diagnostics, data analytics, and AI in support workflows.
  • Operations orientation: Strong background in well-structured operations and running processes that handle incoming work reliably.
  • Hardware or technical background: Preferred, not required. Ability to translate field data into technical discussions with engineering.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: Experience building new structures while keeping operations stable.
  • Proactive support or implementation experience: A plus.

Desired Skills and Attributes

  • Executive presence with C-suite audiences, especially during severe incidents.
  • Data-driven, with the ability to turn metrics into operational decisions.
  • A change agent who thrives under pressure and actively improves processes.
  • A talent developer who builds advancement paths.
  • Understands manufacturing operations, IoT sensors, and asset-intensive industries.
  • Collaborative, influencing across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success without direct authority.
  • Results-oriented, with high ethical standards.

#LI-REMOTE

The base salary range for this full-time position is posted below, plus equity and benefits. Variable pay, bonuses, and other cash compensation will be discussed throughout the interview process.

The salary range was determined by role, level, and location. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range applicable to your location during the hiring process.

$146,000—$183,000 USD

What We Offer:
AssetWatch is a remote-first company that puts people at the center of everything we do. We want our team members to thrive - that’s why we offer a range of benefits and perks designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

  • Competitive compensation package including stock options
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Comprehensive benefits including retirement plan match
  • Opportunity to make a real impact every day
  • Work with a dynamic and growing team
  • Unlimited PTO

We have a distributed team that works remotely across locations in the United States and Ontario, Canada. Collaboration within core working hours is required.

jobs.jobDescription:
Overview

CoinTracker is on a mission to unlock everyone's financial potential so they can build the life they want. We started with crypto, building the tax and portfolio tools that millions of users trust to trade digital assets with peace of mind. Nino builds the next layer of financial fluency for our users. Nino is an AI-powered financial operating system that makes comprehensive, expert-level tax and financial planning advice accessible.

More on Nino: Comprehensive tax and financial planning strategies are currently locked behind high AUM fees or require enough wealth to have a family office. We are turning expert judgment into software so we can serve millions. AI is going to redefine how people understand their finances and how tax advice gets delivered. Not in ten years, in 2026. You can help define that, or spend the next few years adapting to rules someone else wrote. Nino sits inside CoinTracker ($100M raised, partnered with Coinbase, TurboTax, H&R Block, and Thomson Reuters) with the autonomy of an early-stage startup and the reach of an established platform.

Your mission

As Growth Lead, you'll own how the right households find us and book a first conversation with our team. You'll run the website, paid search, AI search and SEO, and our channel with CoinTracker, and you'll ship the work yourself with AI coding tools. Our CPAs, Financial Planners, and sales team close. Your job is to fill their calendars with the right people.

Location: Remote in the US; California preferred.

Your one-year outcomes

  • The right households find us. Qualified consultations held with our team grow 10% week over week, and each channel pays for itself.

  • We know what works. Every consultation traces back to where it came from, and the team trusts the weekly numbers.

  • More than one engine. Paid search, AI search and SEO, and CoinTracker each bring in consultations. No single channel carries the business.

  • Nino is the answer. When people ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google about flat-fee tax and financial planning, Nino shows up.

What you will do

  • Own the funnel from first visit to a held consultation. Set the plan, pick the channels, and own the number.

  • Ship the website yourself. Build and test landing pages, calculators, and comparison pages in our codebase with AI coding tools. No ticket queue.

  • Run paid acquisition. Google Ads first, then continuous experiments across new channels to find what scales.

  • Make Nino the answer in AI search. Content, comparison pages, reviews, and offsite authority, with an agency you direct.

  • Grow the CoinTracker channel. Work with the CoinTracker team to reach its users with the right offer at the right time.

  • Close the gap between booked and held. Scheduling, reminders, and qualification so more booked calls turn into real conversations.

What we look for

  • Role-agnostic

    • Opportunity alignment: You want to bring expert tax and financial advice to households that have outgrown doing it themselves, and you want to do it at an early-stage company where your work moves the number.

    • High agency: You see what needs doing and do it. You don't wait for a brief, a budget, or an engineer.

    • Exceptional collaboration: You make the people around you better: sales, advisors, engineers, and agencies. You say what you think and follow through.

    • First-principles thinking: You start from how customers decide, not from a playbook. You can explain why a number moved.

  • Role-specific

    • 3+ years in growth or performance marketing, ideally at a consumer company that sells a high-ticket service through a call. You've owned a pipeline number for a sales team and hit it.

    • You ship your own work. You've built and launched pages and experiments yourself, and you're comfortable changing a website with AI coding tools.

    • You're hands-on with paid search and know your CAC, payback, and conversion by channel.

    • You've grown AEO/SEO: content, comparison pages, or offsite authority that got cited by AI answer engines or ranked, and you're ready to direct an agency from day one.

    • You read numbers honestly, including small samples and long lags between lead and customer.

    • Bonus: you've marketed in a regulated category (financial advice, tax, insurance, health) and know how to write copy that's compelling and compliant.

jobs.jobDescription:
About the Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

About the Role

We’re looking for dedicated, experienced, and deeply curious individuals to help solve some of the most complex challenges faced by our customers while building the future of post-AGI support alongside us. In this role, you’ll work directly with customers through support tickets and live calls, troubleshooting high-impact issues and resolving novel, often ambiguous technical problems in one of the fastest-moving environments in technology. As AI adoption rapidly accelerates, the work you do will directly support mission-critical systems being built on OpenAI’s platform, serving as a critical line of defense for customers operating at massive scale.

Beyond resolving technical issues, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AGI-driven future. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale.

This Toronto-based role is currently remote and is expected to transition to an in-office arrangement.

In this role, you will:

  • Work directly with customers to troubleshoot and resolve their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, and production incidents. Providing end-to-end ownership through debugging logs, analyzing system behavior, reproducing issues, and delivering expert guidance.

  • Become a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and platform, serving as a go-to resource for complex technical issues.

  • Serve as a critical escalation point and line of defense for complex technical issues, partnering closely with customers and Engineering teams to troubleshoot, resolve, and proactively prevent recurring problems while leveraging scripting and emerging AI capabilities to improve internal tooling and automate operational workflows.

  • Take learnings from resolving customer issues and creating our approach to scaling these solutions, partnering with Product and Go-To-Market teams.

  • Drive operational excellence by identifying opportunities for automation and AI-powered workflows, implementing scalable improvements that increase team efficiency, reducing manual effort, and elevating the overall support experience.

  • Provide occasional holiday and weekend support on call coverage, as needed, to support business and customer needs.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in User Operations, Engineering, Support Engineering or similar technical roles, ideally within high-growth tech startups or other fast-paced environments.

  • Are comfortable using emerging technologies (ie. Codex, ChatGPT, OpenAI API, etc.) to script or engineer code (e.g., Python) for automating repetitive tasks and integrating tools.

  • Have expert-level SaaS troubleshooting skills with the ability to rapidly understand new technologies and complex concepts.

  • Polished enterprise communication and are calm with high-stakes customers during live incident calls.

  • Proven experience building strong relationships with customers and cross-functional partners to drive resolution to complex issues.

  • Exceptional critical thinker and problem solver with the ability to clearly communicate complex technical issues to both customers and internal teams.

  • Thrive in ambiguity, adapt rapidly to change, continuously learn, and proactively seek opportunities for growth.

  • Bring a humble, team first mindset, a genuine eagerness to help others, and the curiosity to quickly learn whatever knowledge is needed to help both your teammates and our customers succeed.

  • Have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, another relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Us:

Homebound is on a mission to make it possible for anyone, anywhere, to build a home using technology. Created by an experienced team of construction, real estate, design, and technology experts, Homebound is transforming the residential construction industry by improving the costly and inefficient process of building a home.

We’ve created an entirely new way to build homes with technology powering every stage from start to finish to provide a seamless experience for our customers. Homeowners across the country can choose where they want to live, select a home plan that’s perfect for them, then personalize and buy it, all online. Homebound has raised $150M in capital from leading venture capitalists like Google, Khosla, Thrive Ventures, and we’re scaling quickly in places like Texas, Colorado and Florida. Come build your future with us.

About The Role:

We're hiring a Tech Lead Manager (Staff+) to lead a small team building the platform that is modernizing homebuilding. This is a leadership-track role for a senior engineer ready to grow their scope and impact. You'll stay hands-on as a technical leader while directly managing a team of 2–4 engineers.

The role blends deep technical ownership with people leadership. You'll set technical direction for your domain, ship production-grade code, and be accountable for the growth, output, and delivery of your team. The work spans the full stack and covers both internal tools that power construction operations and customer-facing experiences for homeowners and trades.

We're a remote-first team. You'll work from wherever you do your best work, with regular offsites to get together in person. You'll own entire product areas, make real technical decisions, and work directly with engineering leadership, product, and design to take features from concept to production.

What You'll Do:

Technical Leadership:

  • Set technical direction for your domain. Contribute to architecture decisions, API contracts, and data models that shape how our systems scale and evolve.

  • Design, build, and deliver features across the platform. You own the full lifecycle from technical design through deployment and monitoring.

  • Stay hands-on. Write and deploy high-quality, production-grade code on a regular basis.

  • Raise the bar across engineering. Review designs, improve developer experience, and help other engineers work through complex problems.

People Leadership:

  • Directly manage a team of 2–4 engineers. Hold regular 1:1s, give clear and actionable feedback, and lead growth and performance conversations.

  • Own your team's delivery. Drive planning, prioritization, and execution, and be accountable for outcomes.

  • Coach and develop your engineers. Help them grow their skills, scope, and careers, and create the conditions for them to do their best work.

  • Partner with product and design to translate messy, real-world processes into clean, reliable software and to make tradeoffs that balance speed and quality.

  • Help grow the team. Recruit, interview, and raise the bar on who we hire.

About You:

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping products that land real-world impact.

  • Experience as a tech lead, team lead, or engineering manager. You've led projects and/or people, whether formally or informally, and prior direct management experience is a strong plus.

  • Built and delivered full-stack features across modern web technologies. Our stack includes TypeScript, Node, React, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS. We care more about your ability to learn and build than checking every box.

  • Actively using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) in your daily workflow. You can explain how they change the way you approach problems and how you'd bring that leverage to a team.

  • Demonstrated leadership and ownership. Mentoring engineers, influencing technical direction, and being the person people depend on.

  • Designed systems that balance quick iterations with long-term reliability and maintainability.

  • Partnered with product, design, and non-technical stakeholders to define requirements, make tradeoffs, and deliver outcomes. Not just code.

Who You Are:

  • You want to grow your scope and impact through leadership, both technical and people.

  • You care about the people on your team. Their growth, their output, and their experience.

  • You take ownership and seek autonomy over your work and outcomes.

  • You're excited to build and lead within a small, nimble, high-impact team.

  • You are self-directed. Comfortable prioritizing your own work and your team's with minimal oversight.

  • You communicate clearly and proactively. Especially in writing.

  • You're humble, good-natured, and bring positive energy to your tea

Our Commitment:

We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. To apply, please submit an application with your resume on the Career’s page.

Homebound is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Homebound considers all qualified applicants in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our Compensation Philosophy:

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Please note that the salary range displayed on each job posting may vary by state. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that each job posting includes a general description of any other compensation offered for the position in addition to the salary range displayed on the job posting. You can find information about our benefits here.
