jobs.jobDescription:
Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane, and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane—a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable.

Our mission is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.

Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across 100+ countries. Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide. We’re a Series B company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, and we’ve raised $69M to date. Learn more at upbound.io

As a Staff Solutions Architect at Upbound, you own the technical success of our customers. You are the primary driver of customer outcomes, from initial implementation through production adoption, ensuring customers achieve real business value with Crossplane and the Upbound platform. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role embedded in the post-sales motion, working closely with customers to deliver working solutions, not just guidance.

In this role, you will own:

Customer Technical Outcomes

  • Drive end-to-end technical success for a portfolio of enterprise customers, from post-sales handoff through production adoption.
  • Own the implementation of known Upbound use cases — control plane architectures, Upbound/Crossplane configurations, GitOps integration, platform engineering patterns — and ensure customers reach their target state.
  • Define and track technical milestones that map to customer business objectives and contract value.
  • Act as the primary technical escalation point when customers face blockers, coordinating engineering and product resources to resolve them.

Implementation & Architecture

  • Lead technical discovery to deeply understand customer environments, platform requirements, and target architecture.
  • Design and deliver Crossplane-based control plane architectures tailored to customer infrastructure and organizational context.
  • Build and maintain reference platforms and implementation accelerators that codify Upbound best practices and reduce time-to-value for common use cases.
  • Contribute Statements of Work that accurately scope implementation engagements.
  • Write code, fix bugs, and build scoped features within Upbound products, provider ecosystem, and Crossplane core where needed to unblock customers.

Technical Voice of the Customer

  • Represent customer technical needs internally to influence product roadmap and prioritization.
  • Partner with pre-sales SEs to ensure smooth, informed handoffs with full context on customer environment and expectations.
  • Identify expansion opportunities as customer technical maturity grows and new Upbound capabilities become relevant.

You are a good fit if you have:

  • Hands-on Kubernetes expertise — operators, controllers, or add-ons; production deployment and management experience.
  • Platform engineering or SRE background, with direct experience building or operating an Internal Developer Platform (IDP).
  • Deep familiarity with cloud-native tooling: CNCF ecosystem, IaC (Terraform/Pulumi), GitOps (Flux/ArgoCD), CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience across at least two major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) at production scale.
  • Strong programming skills; Go is strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of leading customers through complex technical implementations to successful, measurable outcomes.
  • Excellent communication skills — comfortable presenting architecture and trade-offs to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Able to manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously in a fast-moving startup environment.

It is a plus if:

  • Crossplane power user — contributions to core or the provider ecosystem are very appreciated [for many reasons]
  • Active Kubernetes community involvement: contributions, conference talks, technical writing, or open source maintainership.
  • CKA or CKAD certification.
  • Prior startup, familiarity with coding agents and distributed team experience.

#LI-REMOTE

Why Upbound?

At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.

About Upbound

Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries. The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date. For more information, visit www.upbound.io.

jobs.jobDescription:
About the Role

As a Customer Success Manager at NetBox Labs, you will own the success of a regional portfolio of customers. Your primary responsibility is to make sure customers adopt NetBox Labs’ products and see real value from them, which drives strong retention and healthy expansion.

You will be the main point of contact for your customers from onboarding through renewal. You will run regular check-ins, track customer health, spot risk early, and work with Renewals, Sales, Support, and Onboarding to keep every account on track. You will follow proven Customer Success playbooks and help improve them as the team grows.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise customers within your region

  • Build and maintain customer success plans tied to each customer’s goals

  • Partner with Onboarding to ensure a smooth handoff and fast time to value

  • Drive product adoption through regular check-ins, success reviews, and enablement

  • Build strong relationships with day-to-day users and key technical stakeholders, and grow relationships with senior stakeholders

  • Monitor customer health signals and act early on churn risk

  • Partner with the Renewals team to support on-time renewals with no surprises

  • Identify usage and product expansion opportunities and bring them to Sales

  • Work with Support and Engineering to resolve escalations and keep customers informed

  • Share customer feedback with Product so customer needs shape the roadmap

  • Keep customer records and activity up to date in our CS tools

  • Follow team playbooks and suggest improvements based on what you see in the field

What Success Looks Like

  • High gross retention across your portfolio

  • Customers onboarded on time and actively using NetBox Labs

  • Clear, documented success plans for your key accounts

  • Renewals with no surprises, supported by early risk flags

  • Qualified expansion opportunities passed to Sales, driven by adoption

  • Customers who see you as their go-to contact at NetBox Labs

  • Accurate, current customer data that the team can rely on

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related customer-facing role

  • Track record of driving adoption and retention in a SaaS or subscription business

  • Experience working with technical customers and stakeholders

  • Ability to explain technical capabilities in terms of business value

  • Comfort supporting renewal and expansion conversations alongside Renewals and Sales

  • Organized and proactive, able to manage many accounts at once

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills

  • Experience working cross-functionally in a growing organization

Nice to Have

  • Background in infrastructure, networking, DevOps, or automation

  • Experience in a high-growth or scaling SaaS company

  • Experience with open-source software or developer-focused platforms

  • Familiarity with CS platforms and CRM tools

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

jobs.jobDescription:
Walker Sands is one of the fastest-growing integrated B2B marketing agencies in the world. We are looking for a high-impact Associate PR Director to help fuel that continued growth. Total compensation for this role is expected to be between $85,000 - $106,000 per year.

As an agency, we exist to accelerate growth—for our clients, our people and the B2B industry. We partner with B2B technology and services companies, from high-growth Silicon Valley businesses to global Fortune 500 brands, to drive meaningful business results. At Walker Sands, curiosity sparks new ideas, collaboration makes the work stronger, and people are at the center of everything we do. We’re building what’s next for B2B marketing—and we want you to help shape it. As Walker Sands grows, there’s more opportunity to stretch, lead, create, and make your mark.

Walker Sands is looking for a talented Associate PR Director to join our team. As an Associate PR Director, you will lead PR programs end‑to‑end — from high‑level strategy through flawless execution — and do so with confidence, clarity, and authority in front of clients. You’ll shape narratives around some of the most transformative technologies in the market, build influential media relationships, and guide integrated programs that elevate brand awareness, credibility, and reputation.

You’ll also serve as a leader within the agency, mentoring teams, contributing to our culture , and helping shape the future of our Strategic Communications department.

What You Will Do (Responsibilities):

  • Strategic Leadership
    • Own the development of integrated communications strategies for B2B tech clients, especially in industries like IT, Cybersecurity, data, and AI
    • Confidently lead clients through strategic recommendations, program planning, and decision-making
    • Translate business goals and technical concepts into compelling, differentiated narratives
    • Stay ahead of emerging trends in tech, media, and communications, and effectively surface these trends to internal teams and clients
  • Program Ownership + Execution
    • Lead PR programs from strategy through execution ensuring excellence at every stage
    • Guide teams in delivering high-impact media relations, thought leadership, and integrated communications initiatives
    • Develop strong written content and newsworthy pitches that align with client's business objectives and coach teams to do the same
    • Build relationships with a wide range of reporters, creators, analysts and publications to secure coverage across media types
    • Maintain a deep understanding of the evolving GEO landscape and how PR can support AI visibility
    • Bring an AI-forward mindset with an eye towards looking at how to incorporate AI into workflows and build new AI-first workflows
  • Client Partnership
    • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients through managing expectations, providing proactive counsel and navigating complex communications challenges with confidence
    • Build positive rapport and trusted advisor relationships with clients
    • Identify opportunities to expand and strengthen client relationships
    • Participate and support new business efforts
  • Team Leadership + Development
    • Mentor and coach PR team members, fostering growth, expertise, and collaboration
    • Contribute to department and agency culture
    • Champion new tools, processes, and approaches that help to share internal frameworks that improve efficiency, quality, and strategic rigor

Non-Negotiables

  • You crave candid feedback. You embrace it as a powerful tool for growth.
  • You’re incredibly curious. You’re always learning, always sharing, always pushing to get better.
  • You’re proactive. You don’t wait for direction; you bring ideas, solutions, and momentum.
  • You’re collaborative. You make the work better by working well with others.
  • You build media authority. You maintain strong relationships, understand the evolving landscape, and help teams pitch strategically and effectively.
  • You coach communicators. You develop team members into confident storytellers, media strategists, and client partners.
  • You embody agency readiness. You stay steady in pace, navigate shifting priorities, and help your team do the same.
  • You influence with credibility. You articulate a strong point of view, connect decisions to strategy, and guide teams and clients toward the right outcomes without force or ego.

What You Bring (Requirements):

  • Experience: 6+ years of B2B PR experience within an agency setting, with a preferred focus on deep tech including IT, AI, Cybersecurity, or Infrastructure
  • Expertise: Deep expertise in evolving media landscape and the ability to craft compelling narratives around technical topics and engage with a mix of media types
  • Leadership: Proven ability to lead PR programs and teams confidently from strategy to execution
  • Client Management: Strong track record of advising senior level clients and managing complex, high-stakes programs

What We Offer (Compensation + Benefits):

  • Starting Salary: $85,000 - $95,000
    • Base salary is only a part of the total rewards package. Placement on the salary scale will be determined by a variety of factors to ensure internal equity.
    • Starting salaries are not inclusive of a full range of compensation for this role and are instead meant to reflect the expected beginning salary for a new hire dependent on location and experience. Merit-based increases can be earned after time in role.
  • 💰Bonus Potential: This role will be eligible for a bonus based on company performance.
  • 🌱Growth Opportunities: Clear career paths, mentorship programs, and learning events to help you grow professionally.
  • 🌴Flexible PTO and Hybrid Work: Take time as needed for vacations, mental health, or personal days. Includes 8 paid holidays, half-day summer Fridays, and a week off between Christmas and New Year.
  • 🩺 Health Coverage: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans. Mental health resources, pet insurance, and more.
  • 📈Retirement Savings: Employer-matched 401(k) and access to financial planning services.
  • 🛡️ Additional Protection: Life insurance, disability coverage, and other benefits that provide added financial security.
  • 🧠 Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Free, confidential support for you and your household, including counseling, mental health resources, and help navigating life’s everyday challenges.
  • 👶 Family Support: Paid leave for new parents and caregivers, plus policies for fertility treatment, pregnancy loss, adoption challenges, and more.
  • 🎯 Performance & Coaching: Regular performance reviews, clear goal-setting, and ongoing coaching to help you understand expectations, grow your skills, and make progress in your career.
  • 🎉 Milestone Sabbatical: Celebrate five years with a two-week sabbatical and a $2,000 gift.
  • 🤝 Community & Belonging: Employee resource groups, volunteer opportunities, and programs designed to build connection across the agency.
  • 🌟 Culture: Our agency offers an award-winning culture. Read more on our website here!

We strongly encourage people of color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities to apply. As an equal opportunity employer Walker Sands is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion and welcomes everyone to our team.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example – she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

About Quilter

At Quilter, we are helping electrical engineers save time and accomplish more by automating the tedious and time-consuming task of designing printed circuit boards (PCBs). Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high-performance computing (HPC). We are inventing and leveraging novel techniques to solve the decades-old problem of automating circuit board design where today hundreds of billions of dollars are spent. We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full-speed toward our goal.

No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there:

  1. Curiosity

  2. Conviction

  3. Rigor

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join Quilter’s Application Team and help us build the software platform behind the future of circuit board design. We are a team of generalists who pride ourselves on solving new challenges and always learning. You’ll work across the stack to create helpful and friendly user interfaces as well as the services backing them. As one of our early engineers, you’ll have massive ownership and influence over the direction of our product, architecture, and team culture.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in high-ownership environments, loves solving complex technical problems, and is excited by the idea of bridging the worlds of software and hardware development.

Today, the team works mainly with Python and Typescript / Javascript so strong fundamentals with those tools is required.

What You’ll Do

  • Build new customer-facing features from top to bottom (data models, API, UI, and beyond)

  • Create clean, intuitive UIs that empower customers to easily work with complex circuit board data

  • Develop and maintain performant and reliable backend services, data pipelines, and APIs

  • Collaborate with ML, EDA, and electrical engineering experts to integrate novel core algorithms

  • Contribute to architectural decisions, infrastructure design, and internal dev tooling

  • Own large parts of the product—from concept to deployment—in a fast-moving, early-stage team

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience as a software engineer, ideally in a startup or high-velocity environment, but also with some experience in a large collaborative team

  • Strong fluency in TypeScript / Javascript, Python, React, MongoDB, Docker, and Kubernetes

  • Strong experience with automated testing, CI/CD systems, and modern cloud infrastructure

  • Experience with LLM/agentic coding in an enterprise setting, with an understanding of how to maintain code quality

  • Comfortable designing APIs and building backend services from scratch

  • Enthusiastic about shaping product direction and working in a tight-knit, mission-driven team

  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset

  • Comfort navigating ambiguous or unscoped challenges with autonomy

Nice to Have

  • Experience with C++, CUDA, or ML workflows

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Terraform, Kubernetes, AWS

  • Interest or hands-on experience with hardware—from designing PCBs to tinkering with Arduinos, breadboards, or embedded systems

  • Exposure to high-performance computing, simulation tools, or CAD systems

Please note: We are an equal opportunity employer. At this time, we are focused on hiring primarily within the US, with occasional exception to accommodate exceptional talent.

What we offer:

  • Interesting and challenging work

  • Competitive salary and equity benefits

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Regular team events and offsites (~4x / year)

  • Unlimited paid time off

  • Paid parental leave

Want to learn more about Quilter, our vision, and our investors? Visit our About page and visit our Blog.
